    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) internal jurisdictionFlows; // 0x9c

    struct UserInfo {
        uint256 jurisdictionId;
        uint256 totalTokensLocked;
        uint256 startIndex;
        uint256 endIndex;
    }
    mapping(address => address) internal authorizedWalletToUserId; // 0x9d
    mapping(address => UserInfo) internal userIdInfo; // 0x9e

    struct Lockup {
        uint256 lockExpirationDate;
        uint256 numberOfTokensLocked;
    }
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => Lockup)) internal userIdLockups; // 0x9f

    mapping(uint256 => uint256) internal jurisdictionHaltsUntil; // 0xa0
    uint256 internal maxInvestors; // 0xa1
    uint256 internal currentInvestors; // 0xa2
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) internal currentInvestorsByJurisdiction; // 0xa3
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) internal maxInvestorsByJurisdiction; // 0xa4
    mapping(address => bool) internal investorEnlistedMap; // 0xa5
    mapping(address => uint256) internal userActiveWalletCount; // 0xa6
    mapping(address => bool) internal walletActivatedMap; // 0xa7
    mapping(address => address) internal walletToRevokedFrom; // 0xa8

    // ===== Events =====
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event OperatorAdded(address indexed account);
    event OperatorRemoved(address indexed account);
    event ApproveNewUser(address indexed userId, uint256 indexed jurisdictionId, address indexed operator);
    event AddApprovedUserWallet(address indexed userId, address indexed wallet, address indexed operator);
    event RevokeUserWallet(address indexed wallet, address indexed operator);
    event UpdateJurisdictionForUserId(address indexed userId, uint256 indexed jurisdictionId, address indexed operator);
    event UpdateJurisdictionFlow(uint256 indexed fromJurisdiction, uint256 indexed toJurisdiction, uint256 lockup, address indexed operator);
    event AddLockup(address indexed userId, uint256 lockExpirationDate, uint256 numberOfTokensLocked, address indexed operator);
    event UnlockTokens(address indexed userId, uint256 amount, address indexed operator);
    event Halt(uint256 indexed jurisdictionId, uint256 until);
    event Resume(uint256 indexed jurisdictionId);
    event MaxInvestorsChanged(uint256 maxInvestors);
    event MaxInvestorsByJurisdictionChanged(uint256 indexed jurisdictionId, uint256 maxInvestors);
    event InvestorEnlisted(address indexed wallet, uint256 indexed jurisdictionId);
    event InvestorDelisted(address indexed wallet, uint256 indexed jurisdictionId);
    event WalletActivated(address indexed wallet, address indexed operator);
    event WalletDeactivated(address indexed wallet, address indexed operator);
    event ConfigWhitelist(uint256 startDate, uint256 lockupGranularity, address indexed operator);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(isOwner(), "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyOperator() {
        require(isOperator(msg.sender), "OperatorRole: caller does not have the Operator role");
        _;
    }

    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function isOwner() public view returns (bool) {
        return msg.sender == _owner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function isOperator(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        require(account != address(0), "Roles: account is the zero address");
        return _operators[account];
    }

    function addOperator(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _addOperator(account);
    }

    function removeOperator(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _removeOperator(account);
    }

    function renounceOperator() public {
        _removeOperator(msg.sender);
    }

    function _addOperator(address account) internal {
        require(!_operators[account], "Roles: account already has role");
        _operators[account] = true;
        emit OperatorAdded(account);
    }

    function _removeOperator(address account) internal {
        require(_operators[account], "Roles: account does not have role");
        _operators[account] = false;
        emit OperatorRemoved(account);
    }

    function initialize(address _tokenAddress) public {
        require(!_initialized || _initializing == false, "Contract instance has already been initialized");
        bool wasInitializing = _initializing;
        if (!_initialized) {
            _initializing = true;
            _initialized = true;
        }
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
        token = _tokenAddress;
        if (!wasInitializing) {
            _initializing = false;
        }
    }

    function getTokenBalance(address account) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return IERC20(token).balanceOf(account);
    }

    // ===== Views =====

    function jurisdictionHaltsUntilView(uint256 jId) public view returns (uint256) {
        return jurisdictionHaltsUntil[jId];
    }

    function balanceOf(uint256 jurisdictionId) public view returns (uint256) {
        // Returns token balance queried from token, ensuring balance is 0 (strange legacy)
        uint256 bal = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(uint160(jurisdictionId)));
        require(bal == 0, "INVALID_BALANCE");
        _processUnlocks(address(uint160(jurisdictionId)));
        return bal;
    }

    function getStartDate() public view returns (uint256) {
        return startDate;
    }

    function getLockupGranularity() public view returns (uint256) {
        return lockupGranularity;
    }

    function getMaxInvestors() public view returns (uint256) {
        return maxInvestors;
    }

    function getCurrentInvestors() public view returns (uint256) {
        return currentInvestors;
    }

    function getCurrentInvestorsByJurisdiction(uint256 jId) public view returns (uint256) {
        return currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jId];
    }

    function getMaxInvestorsByJurisdiction(uint256 jId) public view returns (uint256) {
        return maxInvestorsByJurisdiction[jId];
    }

    function callingContract() public view returns (address) {
        return token;
    }

    function authorizedWalletToUserIdView(address wallet) public view returns (address) {
        return authorizedWalletToUserId[wallet];
    }

    function walletActivated(address wallet) public view returns (bool) {
        return walletActivatedMap[wallet];
    }

    function investorEnlisted(address wallet) public view returns (bool) {
        return investorEnlistedMap[wallet];
    }

    function userActiveWalletCountView(address userId) public view returns (uint256) {
        return userActiveWalletCount[userId];
    }

    function revokedFrom(address wallet) public view returns (address) {
        return walletToRevokedFrom[wallet];
    }

    function getJurisdictionFlow(uint256 fromJ, uint256 toJ) public view returns (uint256) {
        return jurisdictionFlows[fromJ][toJ];
    }

    function getUserIdLockup(address userId, uint256 idx) public view returns (uint256 lockExpirationDate, uint256 numberOfTokensLocked) {
        Lockup storage l = userIdLockups[userId][idx];
        return (l.lockExpirationDate, l.numberOfTokensLocked);
    }

    function getAuthorizedUserIdInfo(address wallet)
        public view
        returns (uint256 jurisdictionId, uint256 totalTokensLocked, uint256 startIndex, uint256 endIndex)
    {
        address userId = authorizedWalletToUserId[wallet];
        UserInfo storage u = userIdInfo[userId];
        return (u.jurisdictionId, u.totalTokensLocked, u.startIndex, u.endIndex);
    }

    function getLockedTokenCount(address wallet) public view returns (uint256) {
        address userId = authorizedWalletToUserId[wallet];
        UserInfo storage u = userIdInfo[userId];
        uint256 totalLocked = u.totalTokensLocked;
        uint256 start = u.startIndex;
        uint256 end = u.endIndex;
        for (uint256 i = start; i < end; i++) {
            Lockup storage l = userIdLockups[userId][i];
            if (l.lockExpirationDate > block.timestamp) break;
            totalLocked -= l.numberOfTokensLocked;
        }
        return totalLocked;
    }

    function messageForTransferRestriction(uint8 code) public pure returns (string memory) {
        if (code == 0) return "SUCCESS";
        if (code == 1) return "DENIED: JURISDICTION_FLOW";
        if (code == 2) return "DENIED: LOCKUP";
        if (code == 3) return "DENIED: FROM_WALLET";
        if (code == 4) return "DENIED: JURISDICTION_HALT";
        return "DENIED: WALLET_UNKNOWN";
    }

    function maxInvestorsView() public view returns (uint256) {
        return maxInvestors;
    }

    function lockupGranularityView() public view returns (uint256) {
        return lockupGranularity;
    }

    // ===== Mutating =====

    function configWhitelist(uint256 _startDate, uint256 _lockupGranularity) public onlyOwner {
        startDate = _startDate;
        lockupGranularity = _lockupGranularity;
        emit ConfigWhitelist(_startDate, _lockupGranularity, msg.sender);
    }

    function setInvestorLimit(uint256 _max) public onlyOwner {
        require(_max >= currentInvestors, "Less than current investor count");
        maxInvestors = _max;
        emit MaxInvestorsChanged(_max);
    }

    function setInvestorLimitForJurisdiction(uint256[] memory jIds, uint256[] memory limits) public onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < jIds.length; i++) {
            uint256 jId = jIds[i];
            uint256 lim = limits[i];
            require(lim >= currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jId], "Less than current investor count");
            maxInvestorsByJurisdiction[jId] = lim;
            emit MaxInvestorsByJurisdictionChanged(jId, lim);
        }
    }

    function updateJurisdictionFlows(uint256[] memory from, uint256[] memory to, uint256[] memory lockups) public onlyOperator {
        uint256 len = from.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            uint256 f = from[i];
            uint256 t = to[i];
            require(f > 0 && t > 0, "PARAMETER_MISSING");
            jurisdictionFlows[f][t] = lockups[i];
            emit UpdateJurisdictionFlow(f, t, lockups[i], msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function approveNewUsers(address[] memory userIds, uint256[] memory jurisdictionIds) public onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < userIds.length; i++) {
            address userId = userIds[i];
            require(userIdInfo[userId].jurisdictionId == 0, "USER_WALLET_ALREADY_ADDED");
            require(authorizedWalletToUserId[userId] == address(0) || authorizedWalletToUserId[userId] == userId, "USER_ID_ALREADY_EXISTS");
            uint256 jId = jurisdictionIds[i];
            require(jId != 0, "PARAMETER_MISSING");
            authorizedWalletToUserId[userId] = userId;
            userIdInfo[userId].jurisdictionId = jId;
            emit ApproveNewUser(userId, jId, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function addApprovedUserWallets(address[] memory userIds, address[] memory wallets) public onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < userIds.length; i++) {
            _addApprovedUserWallet(userIds[i], wallets[i]);
        }
    }

    function _addApprovedUserWallet(address userId, address wallet) internal {
        require(userIdInfo[userId].jurisdictionId != 0, "USER_ID_UNKNOWN");
        require(authorizedWalletToUserId[wallet] == address(0) || authorizedWalletToUserId[wallet] == userId, "ATTEMPT_TO_EXCHANGE_WALLET");
        authorizedWalletToUserId[wallet] = userId;
        emit AddApprovedUserWallet(userId, wallet, msg.sender);
    }

    function revokeUserWallets(address[] memory wallets) public onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            address w = wallets[i];
            address userId = authorizedWalletToUserId[w];
            require(userId != address(0), "USER_ID_UNKNOWN");
            if (walletActivatedMap[w]) {
                userIdInfo[userId].endIndex--;
                userActiveWalletCount[userId]--;
            }
            authorizedWalletToUserId[w] = address(0);
            emit RevokeUserWallet(w, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function updateJurisdictionsForUserIds(address[] memory userIds, uint256[] memory jIds) public onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < userIds.length; i++) {
            address userId = userIds[i];
            uint256 jId = jIds[i];
            require(jId != 0, "PARAMETER_MISSING");
            userIdInfo[userId].jurisdictionId = jId;
            emit UpdateJurisdictionForUserId(userId, jId, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function halt(uint256[] memory jIds, uint256[] memory times) public onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < jIds.length; i++) {
            uint256 jId = jIds[i];
            uint256 until = times[i];
            require(until > block.timestamp, "HALT_DUE_SHOULD_BE_FUTURE");
            jurisdictionHaltsUntil[jId] = until;
            emit Halt(jId, until);
        }
    }

    function resume(uint256[] memory jIds) public onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < jIds.length; i++) {
            uint256 jId = jIds[i];
            require(jurisdictionHaltsUntil[jId] != 0, "NOT_HALTED");
            delete jurisdictionHaltsUntil[jId];
            emit Resume(jId);
        }
    }

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < userIds.length; i++) {
            _addLockup(userIds[i], dates[i], amounts[i]);
        }
    }

    function _addLockup(address userId, uint256 lockExpirationDate, uint256 numberOfTokensLocked) internal {
        if (numberOfTokensLocked == 0 || lockExpirationDate <= block.timestamp) return;
        emit AddLockup(userId, lockExpirationDate, numberOfTokensLocked, msg.sender);
        UserInfo storage u = userIdInfo[userId];
        require(u.jurisdictionId != 0, "USER_ID_UNKNOWN");
        u.totalTokensLocked = u.totalTokensLocked + numberOfTokensLocked;
        if (u.endIndex > 0) {
            Lockup storage last = userIdLockups[userId][u.endIndex - 1];
            if (lockupGranularity + last.lockExpirationDate >= lockExpirationDate) {
                last.numberOfTokensLocked += numberOfTokensLocked;
                return;
            }
        }
        userIdLockups[userId][u.endIndex] = Lockup(lockExpirationDate, numberOfTokensLocked);
        u.endIndex++;

        UserInfo storage u = userIdInfo[userId];
        require(u.jurisdictionId != 0, "USER_ID_UNKNOWN");

        uint256 last = u.endIndex - maxCount;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < maxCount; i++) {
            if (!_processUserLockup(userId, last, true)) break;
        }
    }

        UserInfo storage u = userIdInfo[userId];
        require(u.jurisdictionId != 0, "USER_ID_UNKNOWN");
        uint256 count = maxLockupIndex - u.startIndex;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            if (!_processUserLockup(userId, 0, false)) break;
        }
    }

        address userId = authorizedWalletToUserId[wallet];
        if (userId == address(0)) return;
        while (_processUserLockup(userId, 0, false)) {}
    }

    function _processUserLockup(address userId, uint256 /*param*/, bool /*flag*/) internal returns (bool) {
        UserInfo storage u = userIdInfo[userId];
        if (u.startIndex >= u.endIndex) return false;
        Lockup storage l = userIdLockups[userId][u.startIndex];
        if (l.lockExpirationDate > block.timestamp) return false;
        emit UnlockTokens(userId, l.numberOfTokensLocked, msg.sender);
        u.totalTokensLocked -= l.numberOfTokensLocked;
        u.startIndex++;
        delete userIdLockups[userId][u.startIndex - 1];
        return true;
    }

    }

        currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jId]++;
        require(maxInvestors == 0 || currentInvestors <= maxInvestors, "EXCEEDING_MAX_INVESTORS");
        require(maxInvestorsByJurisdiction[jId] == 0 || currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jId] <= maxInvestorsByJurisdiction[jId], "EXCEEDING_MAX_INVESTORS_BY_JURISDICTION");

    function _deactivate(address wallet) internal {
        address userId = authorizedWalletToUserId[wallet];
        require(userId != address(0), "USER_ID_UNKNOWN");
        require(walletActivatedMap[wallet], "ALREADY_DEACTIVATED_WALLET");
        userActiveWalletCount[userId]--;
        walletActivatedMap[wallet] = false;
        emit WalletDeactivated(wallet, msg.sender);
        if (userActiveWalletCount[userId] == 0) {
            _delist(wallet);
        }
    }

    function authorizeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount, bool isTransfer) public {
        require(msg.sender == token, "CALL_VIA_CONTRACT_ONLY");
        if (from == address(0) && to == address(0)) return;

        address fromUserId = authorizedWalletToUserId[from];
        require(fromUserId != address(0) || from == address(0), "NOT_AUTHORIZED_WALLET_SENDER");
        address toUserId = authorizedWalletToUserId[to];
        require(toUserId != address(0) || to == address(0), "NOT_AUTHORIZED_WALLET_RECV");

        if (!walletActivatedMap[from] && from != address(0)) _activate(from);
        if (!walletActivatedMap[to] && to != address(0)) _activate(to);

        if (getTokenBalance(from) == amount && from != address(0)) _deactivate(from);
        if (from == to) return;

        uint256 fromJ = userIdInfo[fromUserId].jurisdictionId;
        uint256 toJ = userIdInfo[toUserId].jurisdictionId;
        require(!_isHalted(fromJ), "FROM_JURISDICTION_HALTED");
        require(!_isHalted(toJ), "TO_JURISDICTION_HALTED");
        uint256 lockupLength = jurisdictionFlows[fromJ][toJ];
        require(lockupLength != 0, "DENIED_JURISDICTION_FLOW");
        if (isTransfer && to != address(0)) {
            _addLockup(toUserId, block.timestamp + lockupLength, amount);
        }
        if (from == address(0)) {
            require(block.timestamp >= startDate, "WAIT_FOR_START_DATE");
        } else {
            UserInfo storage fu = userIdInfo[fromUserId];
            while (_processUserLockup(fromUserId, 0, false)) {}
            uint256 bal = getTokenBalance(from);
            require(amount <= bal, "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE");
            require(fu.totalTokensLocked + amount <= bal, "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE_LOCKED");
        }
    }

    function _isHalted(uint256 jId) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 until = jurisdictionHaltsUntil[jId];
        if (until == 0) return false;
        return block.timestamp < until;
    }

    function detectTransferRestriction(address from, address to, uint256 amount) public view returns (uint8) {
        address fromUserId = authorizedWalletToUserId[from];
        address toUserId = authorizedWalletToUserId[to];
        if ((fromUserId == address(0) && from != address(0)) || (toUserId == address(0) && to != address(0))) {
            return 3;
        }
        if (from == to) return 0;
        uint256 fromJ = userIdInfo[fromUserId].jurisdictionId;
        uint256 toJ = userIdInfo[toUserId].jurisdictionId;
        if (_isHalted(fromJ) || _isHalted(toJ)) return 4;
        if (jurisdictionFlows[fromJ][toJ] == 0) return 1;
        amount;
        return 0;
    }
}

    }

        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");

contract TheBattle is ERC721A, Ownable, ReentrancyGuard {
    using Address for address payable;
    using Strings for uint256;

    // storage slot 9
    // owner is slot 9? Actually Ownable's _owner is before this.
    // We map public state vars per slot roughly.
    uint256 public WatchersEnergy;           // slot 10
    uint256 public GuardianSummonEnergy;     // slot 11
    uint256 public ResisterSummonEnergy;     // slot 12
    uint256 public GuardianWins;             // slot 13
    uint256 public ResisterWins;             // slot 14
    uint256 public GuardianCount;            // slot 15 (0x0f)
    uint256 public ResisterCount;            // slot 16 (0x10)
    uint256 public GuardianIncrease;         // slot 17 (0x11 actually storage differs)
    uint256 public ResisterIncrease;         // slot 18
    uint256 public WatchersEnergyTotal;      // slot 19 (0x13) GuardianCount? ambiguous
    uint256 public summonCount;              // slot 20 (0x14) RugPullTreasure?
    uint256 public rugpullEndsAt;            // slot 21 (0x15)
    uint256 public summonEndsAt;             // slot 22 (0x16)
    uint256 public winner;                   // slot 23 (0x17)
    uint256 public imageValidThreshold;      // slot 24 (0x18)

    // slot 25 (0x19) packed: byte0 = activated, byte1 = gameover
    struct GameStatus {
        bool activated;
        bool gameOver;
    }
    GameStatus private _status;

    string private _summonURI;               // slot 26 (0x1a)
    string private _guardianURI;             // slot 27 (0x1b)
    string private _resisterURI;             // slot 28 (0x1c)
    bytes32 public root;                     // slot 29 (0x1d)

    mapping(uint256 => bool) public isGuardian;   // slot 30 (0x1e)
    mapping(uint256 => bool) public claimed;      // slot 31 (0x1f)

    event onEndGame(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed winner, bool guardian, uint256 energy);
    event onWithdraw(uint256 amount, address indexed to, uint256 balance);

    constructor() ERC721A("", "") {}

    // --- View helpers ---

    function getPower(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (!isGuardian[tokenId]) {
            return ResisterWins;
        }
        if (winner == tokenId) return 0;
        return GuardianWins;
    }

    function getRugpullLP() public view returns (uint256) {
        if (block.timestamp < rugpullEndsAt) {
            return rugpullEndsAt - block.timestamp;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    function getOwnCharacters(address owner_) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256 bal = balanceOf(owner_);
        uint256[] memory ids = new uint256[](bal);
        uint256 idx = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < totalSupply(); i++) {
            if (ownerOf(i) == owner_) {
                ids[idx++] = i;
            }
        }
        return ids;
    }

    function watcherEnergy() external nonReentrant {
        require(owner() == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        require(address(this).balance >= WatchersEnergy, "Watcher can't touch the treasure");
        payable(msg.sender).sendValue(address(this).balance - WatchersEnergy);
        emit onWithdraw(address(this).balance - WatchersEnergy, msg.sender, 0);
    }

    function activate() external payable {
        require(owner() == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        require(!_status.activated, "Rugpull is summoned.");
        _status.activated = true;
        rugpullEndsAt = block.timestamp + 43200;
        summonEndsAt = block.timestamp + 3600;
        WatchersEnergy += msg.value;
        _safeMint(msg.sender, 1);
        _setGuardian(0, true);
    }

    function _setGuardian(uint256 tokenId, bool guardian) internal {
        bool wasGuardian = isGuardian[tokenId];
        isGuardian[tokenId] = guardian;
        if (guardian == wasGuardian) {
            if (guardian) GuardianCount++; else ResisterCount++;
            return;
        }
        if (guardian) GuardianIncrease++;
        else ResisterIncrease++;
    }

    function summonGuardians(uint256 quantity, string memory /*proofStr*/, bytes32[] memory proof) external payable nonReentrant {
        require(_status.activated, "Game has not been activated.");
        require(tx.origin == msg.sender, "Watchers defend the power from contracts.");
        require(getRugpullLP() > 0, "");
        require(quantity <= 10, "Exceeded max summon limit. There was no response from the altar.");
        require(msg.value == quantity * GuardianSummonEnergy, "Energy not match. There was no response from the altar.");
        if (block.timestamp <= summonEndsAt) {
            require(_verify(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender)), proof), "Not in whitelist.");
        }
        WatchersEnergy += (msg.value * 26) / 100;
        uint256 currIdx = _currentIndex;
        _extendTime(quantity * 300);
        if (GuardianWins < 9) {
            GuardianWins++;
        } else {
            GuardianWins = 0;
            GuardianSummonEnergy += 80000000000000;
        }
        emit onEndGame(GuardianCount, msg.sender, true, msg.value);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
            _setGuardian(currIdx + i, true);
        }
        _safeMint(msg.sender, quantity);
    }

    function summonResisters(uint256 quantity, string memory /*proofStr*/, bytes32[] memory proof) external payable nonReentrant {
        require(_status.activated, "Game has not been activated.");
        require(tx.origin == msg.sender, "Watchers defend the power from contracts.");
        require(getRugpullLP() > 0, "");
        require(quantity <= 10, "Exceeded max summon limit. There was no response in the dark.");
        require(msg.value == quantity * ResisterSummonEnergy, "Energy not match. There was no response in the dark.");
        if (block.timestamp <= summonEndsAt) {
            require(_verify(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender)), proof), "Not in whitelist.");
        }
        WatchersEnergy += (msg.value * 16) / 100;
        uint256 currIdx = _currentIndex;
        _extendTime(quantity * 600);
        if (ResisterWins < 9) {
            ResisterWins++;
        } else {
            ResisterWins = 0;
            ResisterSummonEnergy += 80000000000000;
        }
        emit onEndGame(ResisterCount, msg.sender, false, msg.value);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
            _setGuardian(currIdx + i, false);
        }
        _safeMint(msg.sender, quantity);
    }

    function _extendTime(uint256 add) internal {
        if (block.timestamp + 86400 > rugpullEndsAt + add) {
            rugpullEndsAt = block.timestamp + 86400;
        } else {
            rugpullEndsAt = rugpullEndsAt + add;
        }
    }

    function _verify(bytes32 leaf, bytes32[] memory proof) internal view returns (bool) {
        bytes32 computed = leaf;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) {
            bytes32 p = proof[i];
            if (computed <= p) {
                computed = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(computed, p));
            } else {
                computed = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(p, computed));
            }
        }
        return computed == root;
    }

    function gainEnergy(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_status.activated, "Game has not been activated.");
        require(tx.origin == msg.sender, "Watchers defend the power from contracts.");
        require(_status.gameOver, "Game is not over.");
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender, "Not the summoner.");
        _gainEnergy(tokenId);
    }

    function _gainEnergy(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        uint256 amount = getPower(tokenId);
        payable(msg.sender).sendValue(amount);
        emit onWithdraw(amount, msg.sender, tokenId);
        claimed[tokenId] = true;
    }

    function gameover() external {
        require(owner() == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        uint256 lastTokenId = totalSupply() - 1;
        winner = lastTokenId;
        _status.gameOver = true;
        bool isG = isGuardian[lastTokenId];
        uint256 share;
        if (isG) {
            share = (ResisterCount * WatchersEnergy) / GuardianIncrease;
            GuardianWins += share;
        } else {
            share = WatchersEnergy;
            ResisterWins += share;
        }
        address to = ownerOf(lastTokenId);
        emit onEndGame(lastTokenId, to, isG, share);
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view override returns (string memory) {
        require(tokenId <= imageValidThreshold, "");
        if (isGuardian[tokenId]) {
            return string(abi.encodePacked(_guardianURI, tokenId.toString()));
        }
        return string(abi.encodePacked(_resisterURI, tokenId.toString()));
    }

    function setImageValid(uint256 v) external {
        require(owner() == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        imageValidThreshold += v;
    }

    function setSummonURI(string memory s) external {
        require(owner() == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _summonURI = s;
    }

    function setGuardianURI(string memory s) external {
        require(owner() == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _guardianURI = s;
    }

    function setResisterURI(string memory s) external {
        require(owner() == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _resisterURI = s;
    }

    function setRoot(bytes32 r) external {
        require(owner() == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        root = r;
    }

    function ApproveToCaller() external {
        require(isGuardian[0] == false || isGuardian[0] == true, "");
    }

    function ConscriptionStartsAt() external view returns (uint256) { return summonEndsAt; }
    function RugPullTreasure() external view returns (uint256) { return WatchersEnergy; }
    function RugPullEndsAt() external view returns (uint256) { return summonCount; }
    function activated_() external view returns (bool) { return _status.activated; }
    function imageValid() external view returns (uint256) { return imageValidThreshold; }

    receive() external payable {}
}

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = ERC721.balanceOf(from) - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        delete _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
    }

    function _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        uint256 lastTokenId = _allTokens[lastTokenIndex];
        _allTokens[tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
        _allTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        _allTokens.pop();
    }
}

abstract contract ERC721Burnable is Context, ERC721 {
    function burn(uint256 tokenId) public virtual {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId), "ERC721Burnable: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _burn(tokenId);
    }
}

abstract contract ERC721Pausable is ERC721, Pausable {
    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal virtual override {
        super._beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);
        require(!paused(), "ERC721Pausable: token transfer while paused");
    }
}

library Counters {
    struct Counter { uint256 _value; }
    function current(Counter storage counter) internal view returns (uint256) { return counter._value; }
    function increment(Counter storage counter) internal { unchecked { counter._value += 1; } }
    function decrement(Counter storage counter) internal {
        uint256 value = counter._value;
        require(value > 0, "Counter: decrement overflow");
        unchecked { counter._value = value - 1; }
    }
    function reset(Counter storage counter) internal { counter._value = 0; }
}

contract Metathug is ERC721Enumerable, ERC721Burnable, ERC721Pausable, Ownable {
    using Counters for Counters.Counter;

    Counters.Counter private _tokenIdTracker;
    bool public sale;
    bool public whitelist;
    uint256 public maxItems;
    uint256 private _reserveCounter;
    uint256 public priceWagon;
    uint256 public maxMint;
    uint256 public maxSale;
    uint256 public priceGun;
    uint256 public price;
    address public devAddress;
    string private _baseTokenURI;

    mapping(address => bool) private _whitelistMap;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _presaleClaims;

    event CreateNft(uint256 indexed id);

    constructor(
        string memory name_,
        string memory symbol_,
        string memory baseURI_,
        address dev_
    ) ERC721(name_, symbol_) {
        _baseTokenURI = baseURI_;
        devAddress = dev_;
        maxItems = 10000;
        maxSale = 20;
        maxMint = 5;
        price = 0.08 ether;
        priceWagon = 0.05 ether;
        priceGun = 0.03 ether;
    }

    function _baseURI() internal view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return _baseTokenURI;
    }

    function baseTokenURI() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _baseTokenURI;
    }

    function setBaseURI(string memory baseURI_) public onlyOwner {
        _baseTokenURI = baseURI_;
    }

    function totalMint() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _tokenIdTracker.current();
    }

    function saleActive() public view returns (bool) { return sale; }
    function whitelistActive() public view returns (bool) { return whitelist; }

    function setMaxItems(uint256 v) public onlyOwner { maxItems = v; }
    function setMaxSale(uint256 v) public onlyOwner { maxSale = v; }
    function setMaxMint(uint256 v) public onlyOwner { maxMint = v; }
    function setPrice(uint256 v) public onlyOwner { price = v; }
    function setPriceWagon(uint256 v) public onlyOwner { priceWagon = v; }
    function setPriceGun(uint256 v) public onlyOwner { priceGun = v; }

    function getPrice(uint256 count) public view returns (uint256) { return price * count; }
    function getPriceWagon(uint256 count) public view returns (uint256) { return priceWagon * count; }
    function getPriceGun(uint256 count) public view returns (uint256) { return priceGun * count; }

    function pause(bool val) public onlyOwner {
        if (val) _pause();
        else _unpause();
    }

    function toggleSale() public onlyOwner { sale = !sale; }
    function toggleWhitelist() public onlyOwner { whitelist = !whitelist; }

    function onPresaleList(address who) public view returns (bool) {
        return _whitelistMap[who];
    }

    function presaleListClaimedBy(address who) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(who != address(0), "Zero address not on Allow List");
        return _presaleClaims[who];
    }

    function addToPresaleList(address[] calldata addrs) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < addrs.length; i++) {
            require(addrs[i] != address(0), "Can't add the null address");
            _whitelistMap[addrs[i]] = true;
            _presaleClaims[addrs[i]] = _presaleClaims[addrs[i]] > 0 ? _presaleClaims[addrs[i]] : 0;
        }
    }

    function removeFromPresaleList(address[] calldata addrs) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < addrs.length; i++) {
            require(addrs[i] != address(0), "Can't add the null address");
            _whitelistMap[addrs[i]] = false;
        }
    }

    function walletOfOwner(address owner_) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256 count = balanceOf(owner_);
        uint256[] memory tokens = new uint256[](count);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            tokens[i] = tokenOfOwnerByIndex(owner_, i);
        }
        return tokens;
    }

    function _mintOne(address to) internal {
        _tokenIdTracker.increment();
        uint256 id = _tokenIdTracker.current();
        _safeMint(to, id);
        emit CreateNft(id);
    }

    function mintReserve(uint256 count, address to) external onlyOwner {
        require(totalMint() <= maxItems, "Sold out");
        require(totalMint() + count <= maxItems, "Max items");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            _mintOne(to);
        }
    }

    function mintMetathug(address to, uint256 wagonCount, uint256 gunCount, uint256 count) external payable {
        require(totalMint() <= maxItems, "Sold out");
        if (owner() != msg.sender) {
            require(!paused(), "Contract is paused");
        }
        uint256 current = totalMint();
        require(count <= maxMint, "Over mint limit");
        require(current + count <= maxItems, "Max items");
        require(current + count <= maxSale, "Not enough left");
        require(sale, "Sale is not active");
        uint256 required = getPrice(count);
        require(msg.value >= required, "Value below price");
        if (whitelist) {
            require(_whitelistMap[to], "You are not on the whitelist");
        }
        uint256 wagonPrice;
        uint256 gunPrice;
        if (wagonCount > 0) wagonPrice = getPriceWagon(wagonCount);
        if (gunCount > 0) gunPrice = getPriceGun(gunCount);
        uint256 total = wagonPrice + gunPrice + getPrice(count);
        require(msg.value >= total, "Value below price");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            _mintOne(to);
        }
    }

    function withdrawAll() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 bal = address(this).balance;
        require(bal > 0);
        (bool ok, ) = payable(devAddress).call{value: bal}("");
        require(ok, "Transfer failed");
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view virtual override(ERC721, ERC721Enumerable) returns (bool) {
        return super.supportsInterface(interfaceId);
    }

    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal virtual override(ERC721, ERC721Enumerable, ERC721Pausable) {
        super._beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }
}

        if (encoded.length == 0) revert EmptyBytes();
        address pointer = _deploy(encoded);
        _addPointer(arr, pointer, decompressedLength, count);
    }

    function _addPointer(Trait[] storage arr, address pointer, uint80 decompressedLength, uint16 count) internal {
        if (decompressedLength == 0) revert InvalidStoredPagesLength();
        if (count == 0) revert TooManyItems();
        arr.push(Trait({count: count, storedPagesLength: decompressedLength, pointer: pointer}));
        // increment corresponding counter happens externally in caller via event; actual count in slot tracked too
        _incrementCount(arr, count);
    }

    function _incrementCount(Trait[] storage arr, uint16 count) internal {
        // Map the array to its sibling counter slot (arr slot + 1)
        uint256 slot;
        assembly { slot := arr.slot }
        assembly {
            let cur := sload(add(slot, 1))
            sstore(add(slot, 1), add(cur, count))
        }
    }

    function _readItem(Trait[] storage arr, uint256 index) internal view returns (bytes memory) {
        uint256 cumulative = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
            Trait storage t = arr[i];
            uint256 newCum = cumulative + t.count;
            if (index < newCum) {
                bytes memory decoded = _decodePage(t);
                uint256 localIdx = index - cumulative;
                // return element at position localIdx in decoded (abi encoded bytes[])
                // We return the raw decoded bytes as a single item list element.
                return _selectFromAbiArray(decoded, localIdx);
            }
            cumulative = newCum;
        }
        revert IndexOutOfBounds();
    }

    function _decodePage(Trait storage t) internal view returns (bytes memory) {
        bytes memory raw = _readPointer(t.pointer);
        (, bytes memory out) = IInflator(inflator).puff(raw, t.storedPagesLength);
        return out;
    }

    function _selectFromAbiArray(bytes memory data, uint256 idx) internal pure returns (bytes memory result) {
        // The decoded data is an abi-encoded bytes[] where the outer length is read from position 0
        // and elements are found via offsets. Simplified version.
        assembly {
            let len := mload(add(data, 0x20))
            if iszero(lt(idx, len)) { revert(0, 0) }
            let ptr := add(add(data, 0x20), mul(add(idx, 1), 0x20))
            result := add(ptr, 0x20)
        }
    }

    function _readPointer(address pointer) internal view returns (bytes memory data) {
        uint256 size;
        assembly { size := extcodesize(pointer) }
        if (size <= 1) return data;
        unchecked {
            size -= 1;
        }
        data = new bytes(size);
        assembly {
            extcodecopy(pointer, add(data, 0x20), 1, size)
        }
    }

    function _deploy(bytes memory data) internal returns (address deployed) {
        bytes memory creation = abi.encodePacked(
            hex"600B5981380380925939F300",
            data
        );
        assembly {
            deployed := create(0, add(creation, 0x20), mload(creation))
        }
        if (deployed == address(0)) revert DeploymentFailed();
    }
}

    // Vault state
    uint256 private _exchangeRate;
    struct AutoFlag { bool automateInterestCollection; address savingsManager; }
    AutoFlag private _autoConfig;
    uint256 private _lastPoke;
    uint256 private _lastBalance;
    uint256 private _fraction;
    address private _pokerAddr;
    address private _connectorAddr;

    // Constants
    address private constant UNDERLYING = 0xC1443cB9CE81915FB914C270D74b0D57d1c87Be0;
    address private constant NEXUS = 0xaFce80b19A8cE13DEc0739a1aaB7A028d6845Eb3;

    uint256 private constant FRACTION_CAP = 5 * 10**17;
    uint256 private constant INITIAL_EXCHANGE_RATE = 10**17;
    uint256 private constant MAX_APR = 1500;
    uint256 private constant TEN_BASIS_POINTS = 10**15;
    uint256 private constant FIVE_PERCENT = 5 * 10**16;
    uint256 private constant INITIAL_FRACTION = 2 * 10**17;

    bool private _initializing;
    bool private _initialized;

    // Events
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);
    event ExchangeRateUpdated(uint256 newExchangeRate, uint256 interestCollected);
    event PokedRaw();
    event Poked(uint256 oldExchangeRate, uint256 newExchangeRate, uint256 interest);
    event AutomaticInterestCollectionSwitched(bool flag);
    event FractionUpdated(uint256 fraction);
    event ConnectorUpdated(address connector);
    event EmergencyUpdate();
    event PokerUpdated(address poker);
    event Referral(address indexed referrer, address indexed beneficiary, uint256 amount);
    event SavingsDeposited(address indexed saver, uint256 savingsDeposited, uint256 creditsIssued);
    event CreditsRedeemed(address indexed redeemer, uint256 creditsRedeemed, uint256 savingsCredited);
    event Deposit(address indexed sender, address indexed owner, uint256 assets, uint256 shares);
    event Withdraw(address indexed sender, address indexed receiver, address indexed owner, uint256 assets, uint256 shares);

    modifier onlyGovernor() {
        require(msg.sender == _governor(), "Only governor can execute");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyPoker() {
        require(msg.sender == _pokerAddr, "Only poker can execute");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlySavingsManager() {
        require(msg.sender == _autoConfig.savingsManager, "Only savings manager can execute");
        _;
    }

    function _governor() internal view returns (address) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = NEXUS.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("governor()"));
        require(ok);
        return abi.decode(data, (address));
    }

    function _getSavingsManager() internal view returns (address) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = NEXUS.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSignature("getModule(bytes32)", bytes32(0x12fe936c77a1e196473c4314f3bed8eeac1d757b319abb85bdda70df35511bf1))
        );
        require(ok);
        return abi.decode(data, (address));
    }

    function initialize(address _poker, string calldata nameArg, string calldata symbolArg) external {
        require(!_initialized, "Contract instance has already been initialized");
        _initialized = true;
        _name = nameArg;
        _symbol = symbolArg;
        _decimals = 18;
        require(_poker != address(0), "Invalid poker address");
        _pokerAddr = _poker;
        _fraction = INITIAL_FRACTION;
        _exchangeRate = INITIAL_EXCHANGE_RATE;
    }

    // ERC20
    function name() external view returns (string memory) { return _name; }
    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) { return _symbol; }
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8) { return _decimals; }
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) { return _totalSupply; }
    function balanceOf(address who) external view returns (uint256) { return _balances[who]; }
    function allowance(address o, address s) external view returns (uint256) { return _allowed[o][s]; }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external returns (bool) {
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");
        _allowed[msg.sender][spender] = value;
        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, value);
        return true;
    }

    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool) {
        _transfer(msg.sender, to, value);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool) {
        _transfer(from, to, value);
        _allowed[from][msg.sender] = _sub(_allowed[from][msg.sender], value, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds allowance");
        emit Approval(from, msg.sender, _allowed[from][msg.sender]);
        return true;
    }

    function increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) external returns (bool) {
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");
        _allowed[msg.sender][spender] = _add(_allowed[msg.sender][spender], addedValue);
        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, _allowed[msg.sender][spender]);
        return true;
    }

    function decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) external returns (bool) {
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");
        _allowed[msg.sender][spender] = _sub(_allowed[msg.sender][spender], subtractedValue, "ERC20: decreased allowance below zero");
        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, _allowed[msg.sender][spender]);
        return true;
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to the zero address");
        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from the zero address");
        _balances[from] = _sub(_balances[from], value, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance");
        _balances[to] = _add(_balances[to], value);
        emit Transfer(from, to, value);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: mint to the zero address");
        _totalSupply = _add(_totalSupply, value);
        _balances[to] = _add(_balances[to], value);
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, value);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 value) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: burn from the zero address");
        _balances[from] = _sub(_balances[from], value, "ERC20: burn amount exceeds balance");
        _totalSupply = _sub(_totalSupply, value, "");
        emit Transfer(from, address(0), value);
    }

    // Vault views
    function asset() external pure returns (address) { return UNDERLYING; }
    function underlying() external pure returns (address) { return UNDERLYING; }
    function unwrapper() external pure returns (address) { return UNDERLYING; }
    function nexus() external pure returns (address) { return NEXUS; }
    function poker() external view returns (address) { return _pokerAddr; }
    function connector() external view returns (address) { return _connectorAddr; }
    function exchangeRate() external view returns (uint256) { return _exchangeRate; }
    function fraction() external view returns (uint256) { return _fraction; }
    function lastPoke() external view returns (uint256) { return _lastPoke; }
    function lastBalance() external view returns (uint256) { return _lastBalance; }

    function maxDeposit(address) external pure returns (uint256) { return uint256(-1); }
    function maxMint(address) external pure returns (uint256) { return uint256(-1); }
    function maxWithdraw(address o) external view returns (uint256) { return _creditsToUnderlying(_balances[o]); }
    function maxRedeem(address o) external view returns (uint256) { return _balances[o]; }
    function balanceOfUnderlying(address o) external view returns (uint256) { return _creditsToUnderlying(_balances[o]); }
    function creditBalances(address o) external view returns (uint256) { return _balances[o]; }

    function totalAssets() external view returns (uint256) {
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = UNDERLYING.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("balanceOf(address)", address(this)));
        require(ok);
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function convertToShares(uint256 assets) external view returns (uint256) { return _underlyingToCredits(assets); }
    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) external view returns (uint256) { return _creditsToUnderlying(shares); }
    function previewDeposit(uint256 assets) external view returns (uint256) { return _underlyingToCredits(assets); }
    function previewMint(uint256 shares) external view returns (uint256) { return _creditsToUnderlying(shares); }
    function previewWithdraw(uint256 assets) external view returns (uint256) { return _underlyingToCredits(assets); }
    function previewRedeem(uint256 shares) external view returns (uint256) { return _creditsToUnderlying(shares); }
    function underlyingToCredits(uint256 a) external view returns (uint256) { return _underlyingToCredits(a); }
    function creditsToUnderlying(uint256 c) external view returns (uint256) { return _creditsToUnderlying(c); }

    function _underlyingToCredits(uint256 amount) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _divPrecisely(amount, _exchangeRate) + 1;
    }

    function _creditsToUnderlying(uint256 credits) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _mulTruncate(credits, _exchangeRate);
    }

    // Deposits
    function depositSavings(uint256 amount) external returns (uint256) {
        return _deposit(amount, msg.sender, true);
    }

    function depositSavings(uint256 amount, address beneficiary) external returns (uint256) {
        return _deposit(amount, beneficiary, true);
    }

    function depositSavings(uint256 amount, address beneficiary, address referrer) external returns (uint256) {
        emit Referral(referrer, beneficiary, amount);
        return _deposit(amount, beneficiary, true);
    }

    function deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver) external returns (uint256) {
        return _deposit(assets, receiver, false);
    }

    function deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver, address referrer) external returns (uint256) {
        emit Referral(referrer, receiver, assets);
        return _deposit(assets, receiver, false);
    }

    function mint(uint256 shares, address receiver) external returns (uint256) {
        uint256 assets = _creditsToUnderlying(shares);
        _deposit(assets, receiver, false);
        return assets;
    }

    function mint(uint256 shares, address receiver, address referrer) external returns (uint256) {
        uint256 assets = _creditsToUnderlying(shares);
        emit Referral(referrer, receiver, assets);
        _deposit(assets, receiver, false);
        return assets;
    }

    function _deposit(uint256 amount, address beneficiary, bool /*isSavings*/) internal returns (uint256 credits) {
        require(amount > 0, "Must deposit something");
        require(beneficiary != address(0), "Invalid beneficiary address");
        if (_autoConfig.automateInterestCollection) {
            address sm = _getSavingsManager();
            (bool ok,) = sm.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("collectAndDistributeInterest(address)", UNDERLYING));
            require(ok);
        }
        (bool ok2,) = UNDERLYING.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("transferFrom(address,address,uint256)", msg.sender, address(this), amount));
        require(ok2, "Must receive tokens");
        credits = _underlyingToCredits(amount);
        _mint(beneficiary, credits);
        emit SavingsDeposited(beneficiary, amount, credits);
        emit Deposit(msg.sender, beneficiary, amount, credits);
    }

    // Redeem
    function redeem(uint256 credits) external returns (uint256) {
        require(credits > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        return _redeem(credits, true, true);
    }

    function redeemCredits(uint256 credits) external returns (uint256) {
        require(credits > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        if (_autoConfig.automateInterestCollection) {
            address sm = _getSavingsManager();
            (bool ok,) = sm.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("collectAndDistributeInterest(address)", UNDERLYING));
            require(ok);
        }
        return _redeem(credits, true, false);
    }

    function redeemUnderlying(uint256 amount) external returns (uint256) {
        require(amount > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        return _redeem(amount, false, true);
    }

    function withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner) external returns (uint256) {
        require(assets > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        if (_autoConfig.automateInterestCollection) {
            address sm = _getSavingsManager();
            (bool ok,) = sm.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("collectAndDistributeInterest(address)", UNDERLYING));
            require(ok);
        }
        uint256 shares = _underlyingToCredits(assets);
        _redeemInternal(receiver, owner, assets, shares, false, true);
        return shares;
    }

    function redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner) external returns (uint256) {
        require(shares > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        if (_autoConfig.automateInterestCollection) {
            address sm = _getSavingsManager();
            (bool ok,) = sm.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("collectAndDistributeInterest(address)", UNDERLYING));
            require(ok);
        }
        uint256 assets = _creditsToUnderlying(shares);
        _redeemInternal(receiver, owner, assets, shares, false, true);
        return assets;
    }

    function _redeem(uint256 inputAmount, bool isCredits, bool /*sendTokens*/) internal returns (uint256 massetAmount) {
        uint256 credits;
        if (isCredits) {
            credits = inputAmount;
            massetAmount = _creditsToUnderlying(credits);
        } else {
            massetAmount = inputAmount;
            credits = _underlyingToCredits(inputAmount);
        }
        _redeemInternal(msg.sender, msg.sender, massetAmount, credits, false, true);
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, credits, massetAmount);
    }

    function _redeemInternal(
        address receiver,
        address owner,
        uint256 assets,
        uint256 shares,
        bool /*unused*/,
        bool /*sendTokens*/
    ) internal {
        require(owner != address(0), "Invalid beneficiary address");
        if (msg.sender != owner) {
            uint256 allowed = _allowed[owner][msg.sender];
            if (allowed != uint256(-1)) {
                require(shares <= allowed, "Amount exceeds allowance");
                _allowed[owner][msg.sender] = allowed - shares;
            }
        }
        _burn(owner, shares);
        (bool ok,) = UNDERLYING.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("transfer(address,uint256)", receiver, assets));
        require(ok, "Must send tokens");
        emit Withdraw(msg.sender, receiver, owner, assets, shares);
    }

    // Unwrap and send
    function redeemAndUnwrap(
        uint256 amount,
        bool isCredits,
        uint256 minOut,
        address output,
        address beneficiary,
        address router,
        bool isBassetOut
    ) external returns (uint256 credits, uint256 massetReturned, uint256 outputQuantity) {
        require(amount > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        require(output != address(0), "Output address is zero");
        require(beneficiary != address(0), "Beneficiary address is zero");
        require(router != address(0), "Router address is zero");

        if (_autoConfig.automateInterestCollection) {
            address sm = _getSavingsManager();
            (bool ok,) = sm.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("collectAndDistributeInterest(address)", UNDERLYING));
            require(ok);
        }

        if (isCredits) {
            credits = amount;
            massetReturned = _creditsToUnderlying(credits);
        } else {
            massetReturned = amount;
            credits = _underlyingToCredits(amount);
        }
        _burn(msg.sender, credits);

        (bool ok2,) = UNDERLYING.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("approve(address,uint256)", UNDERLYING, massetReturned));
        require(ok2);

        (bool ok3, bytes memory data) = UNDERLYING.call(
            abi.encodeWithSignature(
                "unwrapAndSend(bool,address,address,address,uint256,uint256,address)",
                isBassetOut, output, beneficiary, UNDERLYING, massetReturned, minOut, router
            )
        );
        require(ok3);
        outputQuantity = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    // Governance functions
    function setConnector(address c) external onlyGovernor {
        // would refresh exchange rate etc
        _connectorAddr = c;
        emit ConnectorUpdated(c);
    }

    function setFraction(uint256 f) external onlyGovernor {
        require(f <= FRACTION_CAP, "Fraction must be <= 50%");
        _fraction = f;
        emit FractionUpdated(f);
    }

    function setPoker(address p) external onlyGovernor {
        require(p != address(0), "Invalid poker address");
        require(p != _pokerAddr, "Same poker");
        _pokerAddr = p;
        emit PokerUpdated(p);
    }

    function automateInterestCollectionFlag(bool flag) external onlyGovernor {
        _autoConfig.automateInterestCollection = flag;
        emit AutomaticInterestCollectionSwitched(flag);
    }

    function emergencyWithdraw(uint256 amount) external onlyGovernor {
        (bool ok,) = _connectorAddr.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("withdraw(uint256)", amount));
        require(ok);
        _connectorAddr = address(0);
        emit EmergencyUpdate();
        _fraction = 0;
        emit FractionUpdated(0);
    }

    function depositInterest(uint256 amount) external onlySavingsManager {
        require(amount > 0, "Must deposit something");
        (bool ok,) = UNDERLYING.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("transferFrom(address,address,uint256)", msg.sender, address(this), amount));
        require(ok, "Must receive tokens");
        uint256 ts = _totalSupply;
        if (ts > 0) {
            uint256 newRate = _exchangeRate + _divPrecisely(amount, ts);
            _exchangeRate = newRate;
            emit ExchangeRateUpdated(newRate, amount);
        }
    }

    function poke() external onlyPoker {
        _poke();
    }

    function _poke() internal {
        require(_totalSupply > 0, "Must have something to poke");
        uint256 timeSinceLastPoke = block.timestamp - _lastPoke;
        require(_lastPoke == 0 || timeSinceLastPoke > 14400, "Not enough time elapsed");
        _lastPoke = block.timestamp;

        address connectorAddr = _connectorAddr;
        if (connectorAddr != address(0)) {
            uint256 lastBal = _lastBalance;
            (bool ok, bytes memory data) = connectorAddr.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("checkBalance()"));
            require(ok);
            uint256 currentBal = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
            require(currentBal >= lastBal, "Invariant");
            if (currentBal > lastBal) {
                _refreshExchangeRate(currentBal - lastBal, _totalSupply, true);
            }

            uint256 totalCollat = _creditsToUnderlying(_totalSupply);
            uint256 targetBal = _mulTruncate(totalCollat, _fraction);
            uint256 actualBal;
            {
                (bool ok2, bytes memory d2) = UNDERLYING.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("balanceOf(address)", address(this)));
                require(ok2);
                actualBal = abi.decode(d2, (uint256));
            }
            if (actualBal < targetBal) {
                uint256 delta = targetBal - actualBal;
                (bool ok3,) = UNDERLYING.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("approve(address,uint256)", connectorAddr, delta));
                require(ok3);
                (bool ok4,) = connectorAddr.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("deposit(uint256)", delta));
                require(ok4);
            } else if (actualBal > targetBal) {
                uint256 delta = actualBal - targetBal;
                if (delta == actualBal) {
                    (bool ok5,) = connectorAddr.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("withdrawAll()"));
                    require(ok5);
                    (bool ok6, bytes memory d3) = UNDERLYING.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("balanceOf(address)", address(this)));
                    require(ok6);
                    delta = abi.decode(d3, (uint256));
                } else {
                    (bool ok7,) = connectorAddr.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("withdraw(uint256)", delta));
                    require(ok7);
                }
            }

            (bool ok8, bytes memory d4) = connectorAddr.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("checkBalance()"));
            require(ok8);
            uint256 newBal = abi.decode(d4, (uint256));
            require(newBal >= targetBal, "Enforce system invariant");
            _lastBalance = newBal;
            _refreshExchangeRate(0, _totalSupply, false);
            emit Poked(_exchangeRate, _exchangeRate, currentBal > lastBal ? currentBal - lastBal : 0);
        } else {
            _lastBalance = 0;
            _refreshExchangeRate(_totalSupply, _exchangeRate, false);
            emit PokedRaw();
        }
    }

    function _refreshExchangeRate(uint256 interest, uint256 totalCredits, bool /*validate*/) internal {
        require(totalCredits > 0 || interest == 0 || interest < totalCredits, "ExchangeRate must increase");
        uint256 newRate = _exchangeRate + _divPrecisely(interest, totalCredits);
        _exchangeRate = newRate;
        emit ExchangeRateUpdated(newRate, interest);
    }

    // Math helpers
    function _add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256 c) {
        c = a + b;
        require(c >= a, "SafeMath: addition overflow");
    }

    function _sub(uint256 a, uint256 b, string memory err) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b <= a, bytes(err).length > 0 ? err : "SafeMath: subtraction overflow");
        return a - b;
    }

    function _mulTruncate(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return (a * b) / 1e18;
    }

    function _divPrecisely(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b != 0, "SafeMath: division by zero");
        return (a * 1e18) / b;
    }
}

    function safeBatchTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) public override {
        require(from == _msgSender() || isApprovedForAll(from, _msgSender()),
            "ERC1155: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeBatchTransferFrom(from, to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: transfer to the zero address");
        address operator = _msgSender();
        uint256 bal = _balances[id][from];
        require(bal >= amount, "ERC1155: insufficient balance for transfer");
        unchecked { _balances[id][from] = bal - amount; }
        _balances[id][to] += amount;
        emit TransferSingle(operator, from, to, id, amount);
        _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(operator, from, to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function _safeBatchTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(ids.length == amounts.length, "ERC1155: ids and amounts length mismatch");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: transfer to the zero address");
        address operator = _msgSender();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            uint256 id = ids[i];
            uint256 amount = amounts[i];
            uint256 bal = _balances[id][from];
            require(bal >= amount, "ERC1155: insufficient balance for transfer");
            unchecked { _balances[id][from] = bal - amount; }
            _balances[id][to] += amount;
        }
        emit TransferBatch(operator, from, to, ids, amounts);
        _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(operator, from, to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: mint to the zero address");
        address operator = _msgSender();
        _balances[id][to] += amount;
        emit TransferSingle(operator, address(0), to, id, amount);
        _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(operator, address(0), to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 id, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC1155: burn from the zero address");
        address operator = _msgSender();

        require(bal >= amount, "ERC1155: burn amount exceeds balance");

    function _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(address operator, address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) private {

            try IERC1155Receiver(to).onERC1155Received(operator, from, id, amount, data) returns (bytes4 response) {
                require(response == IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155Received.selector, "ERC1155: ERC1155Receiver rejected tokens");

                revert(reason);
            } catch {
                revert("ERC1155: transfer to non ERC1155Receiver implementer");
            }
        }
    }

    function _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(address operator, address from, address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) private {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC1155Receiver(to).onERC1155BatchReceived(operator, from, ids, amounts, data) returns (bytes4 response) {
                require(response == IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155BatchReceived.selector, "ERC1155: ERC1155Receiver rejected tokens");
            } catch Error(string memory reason) {

                revert("ERC1155: transfer to non ERC1155Receiver implementer");

contract CollectionNFT is
    Initializable,
    ERC1155Upgradeable,
    OwnableUpgradeable,
    AccessControlUpgradeable,
    ReentrancyGuardUpgradeable
{
    // Roles
    bytes32 public constant MINTER_ROLE = keccak256("MINTER_ROLE");

    // Metadata
    string private _name;
    string private _symbol;
    string private _tokenURIPrefix;

    // Royalty
    address private _royaltyRecipient;
    uint256 public maxsupply;
    uint256 public totalReservedSupply;
    uint256 public totalsupply;
    uint256 public totalThreePointSupply;
    uint256 public maxMintCount;
    uint256 public dropPhase;
    uint256 public mintprice;

    // roots
    bytes32 public gcfRoot;
    bytes32 public communityRoot;
    bool public isAirdroped;

    // game info
    struct GameInfo { uint256 a; uint256 b; uint256 c; }
    mapping(uint256 => GameInfo) private _gameInfo;

    // Per-user
    mapping(address => uint256) public reserveCount;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => bool)) private _claimedThreePoint;
    mapping(address => bool) public mintedForCommunity;
    mapping(address => bool) public mintedForGCF;

    event claimedFromThreePoint(uint256 indexed id, address indexed user);

    function initialize(
        string memory name_,
        string memory symbol_,
        string memory uriPrefix_,
        address royaltyRecipient_,
        bytes32 gcfRoot_,
        bytes32 communityRoot_
    ) public initializer {
        __Context_init();
        __ERC165_init();
        __ERC1155_init("");
        __Ownable_init();
        __AccessControl_init();
        __ReentrancyGuard_init();

        _name = name_;
        _symbol = symbol_;
        _tokenURIPrefix = uriPrefix_;
        _royaltyRecipient = royaltyRecipient_;
        gcfRoot = gcfRoot_;
        communityRoot = communityRoot_;

        dropPhase = 0;
        totalsupply = 0;
        totalThreePointSupply = 0;
        maxMintCount = 20000;
        mintprice = 70000000000000000;
        maxsupply = 3;
        isAirdroped = false;

        addAdmin(_msgSender());
        addMinter(_msgSender());
        _registerInterface(0x2a55205a);
    }

    function _registerInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) internal {
        require(interfaceId != 0xffffffff, "ERC165: invalid interface id");
        // ERC165 registry not explicitly maintained here
    }

    function name() public view returns (string memory) { return _name; }
    function symbol() public view returns (string memory) { return _symbol; }
    function tokenURIPrefix() public view returns (string memory) { return _tokenURIPrefix; }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view override(ERC1155Upgradeable, AccessControlUpgradeable) returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == 0xd9b67a26 ||
            interfaceId == 0x0e89341c ||
            interfaceId == 0x7965db0b ||
            interfaceId == type(IERC165).interfaceId;
    }

    function uri(uint256 id) public view override returns (string memory) {
        if (bytes(_tokenURIPrefix).length == 0) return "0";
        return string(abi.encodePacked(_tokenURIPrefix, _toString(id)));
    }

    // Admin role (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)
    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()), "Ownable: caller is not the admin");
        _;
    }

    function addAdmin(address a) public onlyAdmin { _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, a); }
    function removeAdmin(address a) public onlyAdmin { _revokeRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, a); }
    function addMinter(address a) public onlyAdmin { _grantRole(MINTER_ROLE, a); }
    function removeMinter(address a) public onlyAdmin { _revokeRole(MINTER_ROLE, a); }

    function setGCFRoot(bytes32 r) public onlyAdmin { gcfRoot = r; }
    function setCommunityRoot(bytes32 r) public onlyAdmin { communityRoot = r; }

    function setMaxSupply(uint256 v) public onlyAdmin { maxsupply = v; }

    function setMaxMintCount(uint256 v) public onlyOwner {
        require(v > 0, "max mint count should be not 0");
        maxMintCount = v;
    }

    function setMintPrice(uint256 v) public onlyOwner {
        require(v > 0, "mint price shold be not 0");
        mintprice = v;
    }

    function setDropPhase(uint256 p) public onlyOwner {
        require(p <= 3, "dropPhase shold be not greater than 3");
        dropPhase = p;
    }

    function setGameRootKey(uint256 id, bytes32 /*root*/, uint256 amount) public onlyAdmin {
        _gameInfo[id] = GameInfo(0, 0, amount);
    }

    function gameInfo(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        GameInfo storage g = _gameInfo[id];
        return (g.a, g.b, g.c);
    }

    function royalty() public view returns (address) { return _royaltyRecipient; }
    function royaltyPercent() public pure returns (uint256) { return 5; }

    function royaltyInfo(uint256, uint256 salePrice) public view returns (address, uint256) {
        return (_royaltyRecipient, (salePrice * 5) / 100);
    }

    function withdraw() public onlyOwner {
        (bool ok, ) = payable(_msgSender()).call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        require(ok);
    }

    function reserve(uint256 amount) public onlyAdmin {
        _mint(_msgSender(), 1, amount, "");
        totalReservedSupply = amount;
        isAirdroped = true;
    }

    function mintForAirdrop(uint256 amount) public onlyAdmin {
        _mint(_msgSender(), 1, amount, "");
    }

    function mint(uint256 id, bytes32[] calldata proof) public payable nonReentrant {
        require(dropPhase != 0, "not the drop period");
        require(id + totalReservedSupply + totalsupply < maxsupply, "overflow maxsupply");
        require(id <= maxMintCount, "too many count for one transaction");

        if (dropPhase == 1) {
            require(!mintedForGCF[_msgSender()], "have already minted to this address");
            bytes32 leaf = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_msgSender()));
            require(MerkleProof.verify(proof, gcfRoot, leaf), "invalid proof");
            _mint(_msgSender(), 1, id, "");
            mintedForGCF[_msgSender()] = true;
            totalsupply += id;
        } else if (dropPhase == 2) {
            require(!mintedForCommunity[_msgSender()], "have already minted to this address");
            require(msg.value >= id * mintprice, "mintprice is not enough");
            bytes32 leaf = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_msgSender()));
            require(MerkleProof.verify(proof, communityRoot, leaf), "invalid proof");
            _mint(_msgSender(), 1, id, "");
            mintedForCommunity[_msgSender()] = true;
            totalsupply += id;
        } else if (dropPhase == 3) {
            uint256 reserved = reserveCount[_msgSender()];
            if (reserved == 0) {
                require(msg.value >= id * mintprice, "mintprice is not enough");
            } else {
                require(reserved >= id, "not enough reserved token");
            }
            _mint(_msgSender(), 1, id, "");
            totalsupply += id;
            if (reserved >= id) {
                reserveCount[_msgSender()] -= id;
                totalReservedSupply -= id;
            }
        }
    }

    function claimFromThreePoint(uint256 id, bytes32[] calldata /*proof*/, address to) public nonReentrant {
        require(_gameInfo[id].b < _gameInfo[id].a, "have already minted all NFTs");
        require(!_claimedThreePoint[id][to], "have already minted to this address");
        _mint(to, 1, 1, "");
        _claimedThreePoint[id][to] = true;
        _gameInfo[id].b += 1;
        totalThreePointSupply += 1;
        emit claimedFromThreePoint(id, to);
    }

    function burn(address account, uint256 id, uint256 amount) public {
        require(account == _msgSender() || isApprovedForAll(account, _msgSender()),
            "Need operator approval for 3rd party burns.");
        _burn(account, id, amount);
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) { digits++; temp /= 10; }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

    function toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) { digits++; temp /= 10; }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {

        require(signature.length == 65, "ECDSA: invalid signature length");

        bytes32 s;

        assembly {

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public override {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public override {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public override {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address o = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == o || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender || _operatorApprovals[o][spender]);
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer of token that is not own");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");
        _beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0);
        emit Approval(from, address(0), tokenId);
        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;
        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            if (reason.length == 0) {
                revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
            } else {
                assembly {
                    revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(_owners[tokenId] == address(0), "ERC721: token already minted");
        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(address(0), to, tokenId, ""), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }
