    function totalSupply() public view override returns (uint256) {
        return _allTokens.length;
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address o, uint256 index) public view override returns (uint256) {
        require(index < balanceOf(o), "ERC721Enumerable: owner index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[o][index];
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) public view override returns (uint256) {
        require(index < totalSupply(), "ERC721Enumerable: global index out of bounds");
        return _allTokens[index];
    }

    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
            _allTokens.push(tokenId);
        } else if (from != to) {
            uint256 lastTokenIndex = _balances[from] - 1;
            uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
            if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
                uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
                _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
                _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
            }
            delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
            delete _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
        }
        if (to == address(0)) {
            uint256 lastTokenIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
            uint256 tokenIndex = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
            uint256 lastTokenId = _allTokens[lastTokenIndex];
            _allTokens[tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _allTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
            delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
            _allTokens.pop();

        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    // ---- Metadata & URI ----
    function totalToken() public view returns (uint256) { return _allTokens.length; }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view override returns (string memory) {
        require(tokenId > 0 && tokenId <= _allTokens.length, "Token does not exist");
        string memory base = baseURI_;
        string memory idPart = _tokenIdPart(tokenId);
        return string(abi.encodePacked(base, idPart));
    }

    function _tokenIdPart(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (string memory) {
        if (randomValue == 0) return "?";
        uint256 maxSup = 8888;
        uint256 mod_ = randomValue % maxSup;
        uint256 id = tokenId + mod_;
        if (id > maxSup) id = id - maxSup;
        return id.toString();
    }

    }

        contractURI_ = uri;
    }

    }

        require(_p < 3);
        phase = _p;
    }

    function isCreator(address addr) public pure returns (bool) {
        return
            addr == 0xd1535726A1e934e69d49166e8E55eE30A3a805DC ||
            addr == 0x66E1fB14692DCf1dC6cA0FFE15D26AC8820485A6 ||
            addr == 0x50FEdF54dA0789F28E11B4c9F4739E333154ee53 ||
            addr == 0x3f0B60c5F0E6C7A98414c4D68C17022C37B58856 ||
            addr == 0xAFfee832705270a73cdC21Fe907a1d08d750FF7e ||
            addr == 0x5edc650E6854abC04229f2B7a91FeF54c2841652 ||
            addr == 0x29d632c1186C40915b7BBcdf31F9ff0C0DBEf167 ||
            addr == 0x36974DA3EAf180ceEC2D0463947190fE4f19Ee42 ||
            addr == 0x3C9579CBa494C27A46D5e6Cb527f548DDa658815 ||
            addr == 0x7F321b53316553a2250e0C7B2711a7d86Dc449Ac;
    }

    // ---- Minting ----
    function mintPreSale(uint256 amount, uint256 maxAllowed, bytes calldata signature) external payable nonReentrant {
        require(msg.value >= mintPrice * amount, "msg.value should be more or eual than price");
        require(phase == 1, "Mint not available on current phase");
        _mintWithSig(amount, maxAllowed, signature, true);
    }

    function mintMainSale(uint256 amount, bytes calldata signature) external payable nonReentrant {
        require(msg.value >= mintPrice * amount, "msg.value should be more or eual than price");
        require(phase == 2, "Mint not available on current phase");
        _mintWithSig(amount, mainSaleMintPerAccount, signature, false);
    }

    function _mintWithSig(uint256 amount, uint256 maxAllowed, bytes calldata signature, bool presale) internal {
        require(msg.sender.code.length == 0, "Contract not allowed");
        uint256 supply = _allTokens.length;
        require(supply + amount <= maxSupply, "sold out");
        require(amount <= 3, "You can't mint more than 3 tokens");

        bytes32 hash = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, maxAllowed));
        bytes32 ethHash = ECDSA.toEthSignedMessageHash(hash);
        require(ECDSA.recover(ethHash, signature) == _signer, "Invalid signature");

        uint256 already = mintedAllSales[msg.sender];
        if (presale) {
            require(already + amount <= maxAllowed, "Already minted maximum on pre-sale");
        } else {
            require(already + amount <= maxAllowed, "Already minted maximum on main-sale");
        }
        mintedAllSales[msg.sender] = already + amount;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = _allTokens.length + 1;
            _safeMint(msg.sender, tokenId);
            originalMinter[tokenId] = msg.sender;
        }
    }

    function mintForGifts() external onlyOwner {
        require(!randomRevealed, "Random already set");
        uint256 amount = maxSupply - _allTokens.length;
        require(amount > 0, "sold out");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = _allTokens.length + 1;
            _safeMint(msg.sender, tokenId);
            originalMinter[tokenId] = msg.sender;
        }
        randomRevealed = true;
    }

    // ---- Reveal via VRF ----
    function reveal() external onlyOwner nonReentrant returns (bytes32 requestId) {
        require(!randomRevealed, "Random already set");
        require(LINK.balanceOf(address(this)) >= fee, "Not enough LINK - fill contract with faucet");
        randomRevealed = true;
        requestId = requestRandomness(keyHash, fee);
    }

    function fulfillRandomness(bytes32, uint256 randomness) internal override {
        randomValue = randomness;
    }

    // ---- Withdraw ----
    function withdrawAll() external {
        require(_owner == msg.sender || isCreator(msg.sender));
        uint256 bal = address(this).balance;
        require(bal > 0);
        _send(0xd1535726A1e934e69d49166e8E55eE30A3a805DC, (bal * 3) / 100);
        _send(0x66E1fB14692DCf1dC6cA0FFE15D26AC8820485A6, (bal * 3) / 100);
        _send(0x50FEdF54dA0789F28E11B4c9F4739E333154ee53, (bal * 3) / 100);
        _send(0x3f0B60c5F0E6C7A98414c4D68C17022C37B58856, (bal * 2) / 100);
        _send(0xAFfee832705270a73cdC21Fe907a1d08d750FF7e, (bal * 6) / 100);
        _send(0x5edc650E6854abC04229f2B7a91FeF54c2841652, (bal * 20) / 100);
        _send(0x29d632c1186C40915b7BBcdf31F9ff0C0DBEf167, (bal * 20) / 100);
        _send(0x36974DA3EAf180ceEC2D0463947190fE4f19Ee42, (bal * 20) / 100);
        _send(0x3C9579CBa494C27A46D5e6Cb527f548DDa658815, (bal * 20) / 100);
        _send(0x7F321b53316553a2250e0C7B2711a7d86Dc449Ac, address(this).balance);
    }

    function _send(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, ) = payable(to).call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok, "send failed");
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

        automatedMarketMakerPairs[pair] = v;
        _isAMM[pair] = v;
    }

    function allowTrading() external onlyOwner {
        swapAndLiquifyEnabled = true;
        if (_launchTime == 0) _launchTime = block.timestamp;
    }

    function pauseTrading() external onlyOwner { swapAndLiquifyEnabled = false; }
    function canTrade() external view returns (bool) { return swapAndLiquifyEnabled; }

    function claimTokens() external onlyOwner {
        (bool ok,) = payable(marketingWallet).call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        require(ok);
    }

    function claimOtherTokens(address tokenAddr, address to) external onlyOwner {
        require(to != address(0), "walletAddress can't be 0 address");
        IERC20(tokenAddr).safeTransfer(to, IERC20(tokenAddr).balanceOf(address(this)));
    }

    function clearStuckBalance(address to) external onlyOwner {
        require(to != address(0), "walletAddress can't be 0 address");
        (bool ok,) = payable(to).call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        require(ok);
    }

    function burnWallet() external pure returns (address) { return 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD; }

    function _approve(address owner_, address spender, uint256 amount) private {
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");
        _allowances[owner_][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(owner_, spender, amount);
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from the zero address");
        require(amount > 0, "Transfer amount must be greater than zero");

        // cooldown-like check (simplified)
        if (_cooldown[from] != 0) {
            require(_cooldown[from] + 1 > block.timestamp, "");
        }

        bool takeFee = !(_isExcludedFromFee[from] || _isExcludedFromFee[to]);
        if (!_isExcludedFromMaxWallet[to] && !automatedMarketMakerPairs[to]) {
            require(balanceOf(to) + amount <= maxWalletSize, "Max wallet size exceeded");
        }

        _tokenTransfer(from, to, amount, takeFee);
    }

    function _tokenTransfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount, bool takeFee) private {
        if (!takeFee) _removeAllFee();
        if (_isExcluded[sender] && !_isExcluded[recipient]) {
            _transferFromExcluded(sender, recipient, amount);
        } else if (!_isExcluded[sender] && _isExcluded[recipient]) {
            _transferToExcluded(sender, recipient, amount);
        } else if (_isExcluded[sender] && _isExcluded[recipient]) {
            _transferBothExcluded(sender, recipient, amount);
        } else {
            _transferStandard(sender, recipient, amount);
        }
        if (!takeFee) _restoreAllFee();
    }

    function _transferStandard(address s, address r, uint256 a) private {
        (uint256 rAmount, uint256 rTransferAmount, uint256 rFee, uint256 tTransferAmount, uint256 tFee, uint256 tLiquidity) = _getValues(a);
        _rOwned[s] = _rOwned[s].sub(rAmount);
        _rOwned[r] = _rOwned[r].add(rTransferAmount);
        _takeLiquidity(tLiquidity);
        _reflectFee(rFee, tFee);
        emit Transfer(s, r, tTransferAmount);
    }

    function _transferToExcluded(address s, address r, uint256 a) private {
        (uint256 rAmount, uint256 rTransferAmount, uint256 rFee, uint256 tTransferAmount, uint256 tFee, uint256 tLiquidity) = _getValues(a);
        _rOwned[s] = _rOwned[s].sub(rAmount);
        _tOwned[r] = _tOwned[r].add(tTransferAmount);
        _rOwned[r] = _rOwned[r].add(rTransferAmount);
        _takeLiquidity(tLiquidity);
        _reflectFee(rFee, tFee);
        emit Transfer(s, r, tTransferAmount);
    }

    function _transferFromExcluded(address s, address r, uint256 a) private {
        (uint256 rAmount, uint256 rTransferAmount, uint256 rFee, uint256 tTransferAmount, uint256 tFee, uint256 tLiquidity) = _getValues(a);
        _tOwned[s] = _tOwned[s].sub(a);
        _rOwned[s] = _rOwned[s].sub(rAmount);
        _rOwned[r] = _rOwned[r].add(rTransferAmount);
        _takeLiquidity(tLiquidity);
        _reflectFee(rFee, tFee);
        emit Transfer(s, r, tTransferAmount);
    }

    function _transferBothExcluded(address s, address r, uint256 a) private {
        (uint256 rAmount, uint256 rTransferAmount, uint256 rFee, uint256 tTransferAmount, uint256 tFee, uint256 tLiquidity) = _getValues(a);
        _tOwned[s] = _tOwned[s].sub(a);
        _rOwned[s] = _rOwned[s].sub(rAmount);
        _tOwned[r] = _tOwned[r].add(tTransferAmount);
        _rOwned[r] = _rOwned[r].add(rTransferAmount);
        _takeLiquidity(tLiquidity);
        _reflectFee(rFee, tFee);
        emit Transfer(s, r, tTransferAmount);
    }

    function _reflectFee(uint256 rFee, uint256 tFee) private {
        _rTotal = _rTotal - rFee;
        _tFeeTotal = _tFeeTotal + tFee;
    }

    function _takeLiquidity(uint256 tLiquidity) private {
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        uint256 rLiquidity = tLiquidity.mul(currentRate);
        _rOwned[address(this)] = _rOwned[address(this)].add(rLiquidity);
        if (_isExcluded[address(this)]) _tOwned[address(this)] = _tOwned[address(this)].add(tLiquidity);
    }

    uint256 private _storedTaxFee;
    uint256 private _storedLiqFee;

    function _removeAllFee() private {
        _storedTaxFee = _taxFeeBuy;
        _storedLiqFee = _liquidityFeeBuy;
        _taxFeeBuy = 0;
        _liquidityFeeBuy = 0;
    }

    function _restoreAllFee() private {
        _taxFeeBuy = _storedTaxFee;
        _liquidityFeeBuy = _storedLiqFee;
    }

    function _getValues(uint256 tAmount) private view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        (uint256 tTransferAmount, uint256 tFee, uint256 tLiquidity) = _getTValues(tAmount);
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        (uint256 rAmount, uint256 rTransferAmount, uint256 rFee) = _getRValues(tAmount, tFee, tLiquidity, currentRate);
        return (rAmount, rTransferAmount, rFee, tTransferAmount, tFee, tLiquidity);
    }

    function _getTValues(uint256 tAmount) private view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 tFee = tAmount.mul(_taxFeeBuy).div(_feeDenominator);
        uint256 tLiquidity = tAmount.mul(_liquidityFeeBuy).div(_feeDenominator);
        uint256 tTransferAmount = tAmount.sub(tFee).sub(tLiquidity);
        return (tTransferAmount, tFee, tLiquidity);
    }

    function _getRValues(uint256 tAmount, uint256 tFee, uint256 tLiquidity, uint256 currentRate) private pure returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 rAmount = tAmount.mul(currentRate);
        uint256 rFee = tFee.mul(currentRate);
        uint256 rLiquidity = tLiquidity.mul(currentRate);
        uint256 rTransferAmount = rAmount.sub(rFee).sub(rLiquidity);
        return (rAmount, rTransferAmount, rFee);
    }

    function _getRate() private view returns (uint256) {
        (uint256 rSupply, uint256 tSupply) = _getCurrentSupply();
        return rSupply / tSupply;
    }

    function _getCurrentSupply() private view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 rSupply = _rTotal;
        uint256 tSupply = _tTotal;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _excluded.length; i++) {
            if (_rOwned[_excluded[i]] > rSupply || _tOwned[_excluded[i]] > tSupply) return (_rTotal, _tTotal);
            rSupply = rSupply - _rOwned[_excluded[i]];
            tSupply = tSupply - _tOwned[_excluded[i]];
        }
        if (rSupply < _rTotal / _tTotal) return (_rTotal, _tTotal);
        return (rSupply, tSupply);
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

    mapping(address => uint256) private _erc20TotalReleased; // 0x1ca
    mapping(IERC20 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _erc20Released; // 0x1cb

    // ---- Multi-stage configuration ----
    mapping(uint8 => mapping(address => bool)) private _whitelisted; // 0x12d
    mapping(uint8 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _stageMinted; // 0x12e (1st map: count)
    mapping(uint8 => bytes32) private _merkleRoots; // 0x012d? kept separately
    mapping(uint8 => uint256) private _prices; // 0x012e (balance limit group)
    mapping(uint8 => uint256) private _balanceLimits; // 0x193
    bytes32 private _salt; // 0x1f7

    event ApprovalForAll(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, bool approved);
    event PaymentReceived(address from, uint256 amount);
    event PayeeAdded(address account, uint256 shares);
    event PaymentReleased(address to, uint256 amount);
    event ERC20PaymentReleased(IERC20 indexed token, address to, uint256 amount);
    event RoyaltiesSet(address recipient, uint256 basisPoints);

    // ---- Errors ----

    error ApprovalQueryForNonexistentToken();
    error TransferCallerNotOwnerNorApproved();
    error TransferFromIncorrectOwner();
    error TransferToZeroAddress();
    error TransferToNonERC721ReceiverImplementer();
    error MintZeroQuantity();
    error MintToZeroAddress();
    error BalanceQueryForZeroAddress();
    error OwnerQueryForNonexistentToken();
    error URIQueryForNonexistentToken();

    error InvalidQueryRange();

        _initializing = true;

    // ---- ERC165 ----
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == 0x2a55205a || // ERC2981
            interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || // ERC165
            interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd || // ERC721
            interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f;   // ERC721Metadata
    }

    // ---- Metadata ----
    function name() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _s().name;
    }

    function symbol() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _s().symbol;
    }

    function prefix() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _prefix;
    }

    function suffix() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _suffix;
    }

    function setPrefix(string calldata v) external onlyAdmin {
        _prefix = v;
    }

    function setSuffix(string calldata v) external onlyAdmin {
        _suffix = v;
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (string memory) {
        if (!_exists(tokenId)) revert URIQueryForNonexistentToken();
        return string(abi.encodePacked(_prefix, _toString(tokenId), _suffix));
    }

    // ---- Owner ----
    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, newOwner);
    }

    // ---- Admin ----
    function isAdmin(address a) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isAdmin[a];
    }

    function setAdminPermissions(address a, bool v) external onlyOwner {
        _isAdmin[a] = v;
    }

    // ---- ERC721A core ----
    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        ERC721AStorage storage s = _s();
        unchecked {
            return s.currentIndex - s.burnCounter;
        }
    }

    function _totalMinted() internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _s().currentIndex;
    }

    function balanceOf(address a) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (a == address(0)) revert BalanceQueryForZeroAddress();
        return _s().packedAddressData[a] & type(uint64).max;
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return tokenId < _s().currentIndex && (_s().packedOwnerships[tokenId] & (1 << 224)) == 0;
    }

    function _ownershipOf(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (TokenOwnership memory) {
        TokenOwnership memory o;
        if (tokenId < _s().currentIndex) {
            uint256 packed = _s().packedOwnerships[tokenId];
            if ((packed & (1 << 224)) == 0) {
                while (packed == 0) {
                    unchecked { tokenId--; }
                    packed = _s().packedOwnerships[tokenId];
                }
                o.addr = address(uint160(packed));
                o.startTimestamp = uint64(packed >> 160);
                o.burned = (packed & (1 << 224)) != 0;
                o.extraData = uint24(packed >> 232);
                return o;
            }
        }
        revert OwnerQueryForNonexistentToken();
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        return _ownershipOf(tokenId).addr;
    }

    function explicitOwnershipOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (TokenOwnership memory) {
        TokenOwnership memory o;
        if (tokenId < _s().currentIndex) {
            uint256 packed = _s().packedOwnerships[tokenId];
            if ((packed & (1 << 224)) == 0) {
                return _ownershipOf(tokenId);
            }
            o.addr = address(uint160(packed));
            o.startTimestamp = uint64(packed >> 160);
            o.burned = true;
            o.extraData = uint24(packed >> 232);
        }
        return o;
    }

    function explicitOwnershipsOf(uint256[] calldata ids) external view returns (TokenOwnership[] memory) {
        TokenOwnership[] memory out = new TokenOwnership[](ids.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            out[i] = explicitOwnershipOf(ids[i]);
        }
        return out;
    }

    function tokensOfOwner(address a) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256 bal = balanceOf(a);
        uint256[] memory out = new uint256[](bal);
        TokenOwnership memory o;
        uint256 idx = 0;
        uint256 end = _s().currentIndex;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < end && idx < bal; i++) {
            o = explicitOwnershipOf(i);
            if (!o.burned && o.addr != address(0) && o.addr == a) {
                out[idx++] = i;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    function tokensOfOwnerIn(address a, uint256 start, uint256 stop) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        if (start >= stop) revert InvalidQueryRange();
        uint256 end = _s().currentIndex;
        if (stop > end) stop = end;
        uint256 bal = balanceOf(a);
        uint256 maxLen = stop - start;
        if (maxLen > bal) maxLen = bal;
        uint256[] memory out = new uint256[](maxLen);
        if (maxLen == 0) return out;
        uint256 idx = 0;
        TokenOwnership memory o = explicitOwnershipOf(start);
        for (uint256 i = start; i < stop && idx < maxLen; i++) {
            o = explicitOwnershipOf(i);
            if (!o.burned && o.addr != address(0) && o.addr == a) {
                out[idx++] = i;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ---- Approvals ----
    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        address o = ownerOf(tokenId);
        if (msg.sender != o && !isApprovedForAll(o, msg.sender)) {
            revert ApprovalCallerNotOwnerNorApproved();
        }
        _s().tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(o, to, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        if (!_exists(tokenId)) revert ApprovalQueryForNonexistentToken();
        return _s().tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "ERC721A: approve to caller");
        _s().operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address ownerAddr, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _s().operatorApprovals[ownerAddr][operator];
    }

    // ---- Transfers ----
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 ret) {
                if (ret != IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector) {
                    revert TransferToNonERC721ReceiverImplementer();
                }
            } catch {
                revert TransferToNonERC721ReceiverImplementer();
            }
        }
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        address prevOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        if (prevOwner != from) revert TransferFromIncorrectOwner();
        bool approved = msg.sender == from || isApprovedForAll(from, msg.sender) || _s().tokenApprovals[tokenId] == msg.sender;
        if (!approved) revert TransferCallerNotOwnerNorApproved();
        if (to == address(0)) revert TransferToZeroAddress();

        delete _s().tokenApprovals[tokenId];
        unchecked {
            _s().packedAddressData[from]--;
            _s().packedAddressData[to]++;
        }
        _s().packedOwnerships[tokenId] = uint256(uint160(to)) | (uint256(block.timestamp) << 160) | (1 << 225);

        uint256 next = tokenId + 1;
        if (_s().packedOwnerships[next] == 0 && next < _s().currentIndex) {
            _s().packedOwnerships[next] = _s().packedOwnerships[tokenId];
        }
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    // ---- Mint internals ----
    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 quantity) internal {
        uint256 startTokenId = _s().currentIndex;
        if (quantity == 0) revert MintZeroQuantity();
        unchecked {
            _s().packedAddressData[to] += quantity * ((1 << 64) | 1);
            _s().packedOwnerships[startTokenId] =
                uint256(uint160(to)) |
                (block.timestamp << 160) |
                (quantity == 1 ? uint256(1 << 225) : 0);

            uint256 end = startTokenId + quantity;
            for (uint256 i = startTokenId; i < end; i++) {
                emit Transfer(address(0), to, i);
            }
            _s().currentIndex = end;
        }
        require(quantity != 0, "MintZero");
    }

    // ---- Stage / Multi-stage ----
    function stage() public view returns (uint8) {
        return _stage;
    }

    function setStage(uint8 v) external onlyAdmin {
        _stage = v;
    }

    function price(uint8 s) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _prices[s];
    }

    function setPrice(uint8 s, uint256 p) external onlyAdmin {
        _prices[s] = p;
    }

    function balanceLimit(uint8 s) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _balanceLimits[s];
    }

    function updateBalanceLimit(uint8 s, uint256 v) external onlyAdmin {
        _balanceLimits[s] = v;
    }

    function merkleTreeRoot(uint8 s) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _merkleRoots[s];
    }

    function updateMerkleTreeRoot(uint8 s, bytes32 r) external onlyAdmin {
        _merkleRoots[s] = r;
    }

    function remainingBalance(uint8 s, address a) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _balanceLimits[s] - _stageMinted[s][a];
    }

    function currentBalance(uint8 s, address a) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _stageMinted[s][a];
    }

    function isWhitelisted(uint8 s, address a, bytes32[] calldata /*proof*/) public view returns (bool) {
        return _whitelisted[s][a];
    }

    function addToWhitelist(uint8 s, address[] calldata addrs) external onlyAdmin {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < addrs.length; i++) {
            _whitelisted[s][addrs[i]] = true;
        }
    }

    function removeFromWhitelist(uint8 s, address[] calldata addrs) external onlyAdmin {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < addrs.length; i++) {
            _whitelisted[s][addrs[i]] = false;
        }
    }

    function payeesLength() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _payees.length;
    }

    // ---- Public mint flows ----
    function publicMint(uint256 quantity) external payable {
        require(_stage == 1, "Current stage is not enabled");
        _checkAndTrackMint(1, msg.sender, quantity);
        _checkSupply(msg.sender, quantity);
        _handlePayment(quantity * _prices[1]);
    }

    function multiStageMint(uint256 quantity, bytes32[] calldata /*proof*/, uint8 s) external payable {
        require(_stage == s, "Current stage is not enabled");
        require(_whitelisted[s][msg.sender], "Not whitelisted");
        _checkAndTrackMint(s, msg.sender, quantity);
        _checkSupply(msg.sender, quantity);
        _handlePayment(quantity * _prices[s]);
    }

    function adminMint(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata quantities) external onlyAdmin {
        require(recipients.length == quantities.length, "Admin mint: bad request");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            _checkSupply(recipients[i], quantities[i]);
        }
    }

    function _checkAndTrackMint(uint8 s, address a, uint256 quantity) internal {
        _stageMinted[s][a] += quantity;
        require(_stageMinted[s][a] <= _balanceLimits[s], "Exceeds limit");

        require(msg.value >= required, "Insufficient value");
        uint256 refund = msg.value - required;
        if (refund > 0) {
            (bool ok,) = msg.sender.call{value: refund}("");
            require(ok);
        }
    }

    // ---- Max supply ----
    function maxSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxSupply;
    }

    function setMaxSupply(uint256 v) external onlyAdmin {
        _maxSupply = v;

        _royalty = RoyaltyInfo(recipient, uint96(basisPoints));
        emit RoyaltiesSet(recipient, basisPoints);

    // ---- Payment Splitter ----
    function totalShares() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalShares;
    }

    function totalReleased() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalReleased;
    }

    function totalReleased(IERC20 token) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _erc20TotalReleased[address(token)];
    }

        return _shares[account];

        return _released[account];

    }

    function payee(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return _payees[index];

        uint256 totalReceived = token.balanceOf(address(this)) + _erc20TotalReleased[address(token)];
        return _pendingPayment(account, totalReceived, _erc20Released[token][account]);

    }

        require(payment != 0, "PaymentSplitter: account is not due payment");
        _released[account] += payment;
        _totalReleased += payment;
        _sendValue(account, payment);
        emit PaymentReleased(account, payment);
    }

    function release(IERC20 token, address account) public {
        require(_shares[account] > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account has no shares");
        uint256 payment = this.releasable(token, account);
        require(payment != 0, "PaymentSplitter: account is not due payment");

    function releaseAll() external {

    }

    function releaseAll(IERC20 token) external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _payees.length; i++) {
            address a = _payees[i];
            release(token, a);
        }
    }

    function _sendValue(address payable to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(address(this).balance >= amount, "Address: insufficient balance");
        (bool ok,) = to.call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok, "Address: unable to send value");
    }

    function _addPayee(address account, uint256 sharesAmount) internal {
        require(account != address(0), "PaymentSplitter: account is the zero address");
        require(sharesAmount > 0, "PaymentSplitter: shares are 0");
        require(_shares[account] == 0, "PaymentSplitter: account already has shares");
        _payees.push(account);
        _shares[account] = sharesAmount;
        _totalShares += sharesAmount;
        emit PayeeAdded(account, sharesAmount);
    }

    // ---- Initializer ----
    function initialize(
        bytes32 /*a*/,
        bytes32 /*b*/,
        bytes32 /*c*/,
        address /*d*/,
        uint256 /*e*/,
        address[] calldata payees_,
        uint256[] calldata shares_
    ) external initializer {
        require(payees_.length == shares_.length, "PaymentSplitter: payees and shares length mismatch");
        require(payees_.length > 0, "PaymentSplitter: no payees");

        ERC721AStorage storage s = _s();
        s.name = "Placeholder";
        s.symbol = "PLH";

        _owner = msg.sender;
        _isAdmin[msg.sender] = true;

        _prices[2] = 0.0067 ether;
        _balanceLimits[2] = 2;
        _merkleRoots[2] = bytes32(uint256(0));

        _prices[3] = 0;
        _balanceLimits[3] = 3;
        _merkleRoots[3] = bytes32(uint256(0));

        _prices[4] = 0.01 ether;
        _balanceLimits[4] = 4;
        _merkleRoots[4] = bytes32(uint256(0));

        _prices[1] = 0.01 ether;
        _balanceLimits[1] = 2;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < payees_.length; i++) {
            _addPayee(payees_[i], shares_[i]);
        }
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 tmp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (tmp != 0) { digits++; tmp /= 10; }
        bytes memory buf = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buf[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + value % 10));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buf);
    }
}

    // --- ERC721 storage ---
    string private _name;         // slot 0
    string private _symbol;       // slot 1
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners;       // slot 2
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;     // slot 3
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals; // slot 4
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals; // slot 5

    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _ownedTokens; // slot 6
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ownedTokensIndex; // slot 7
    uint256[] private _allTokens; // slot 8
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _allTokensIndex; // slot 9

    address public OPERATOR_FILTER_REGISTRY; // slot 0xc (approx)

    // keep slot layout simple
    string public baseURI;       // slot 0xf
    string public baseExtension; // slot 0x10

    address public treasury;     // slot 0xa
    address public godsToken;    // slot 0x11 (treasury token for payments)
    uint256 public godsFee;      // slot 0x12
    bool public canRent;         // slot 0x13

    struct RentInfo {
        address user;
        uint64 expires;
    }
    mapping(uint256 => RentInfo) private _users; // slot 0x15
    mapping(address => bool) public allowedTokens; // slot 0x14

    struct Rentable {
        uint256 tokenId;
        uint256 amount;
        address lender;
        uint256 deadline;
        address paymentToken;
        uint64 duration;
    }
    mapping(uint256 => Rentable) public rentableItems; // slot 0x16

    uint256 public rentBidsCounter; // slot 0x17
    struct Bid {
        uint256 bidId;
        uint256 tokenId;
        address bidder;
        uint256 amount;
        address paymentToken;
        uint64 duration;
    }
    mapping(uint256 => Bid) public rentBids; // slot 0x18

    mapping(uint256 => bool) public isSloth; // slot 0xd

    uint256 private _airdropCursor; // slot 0xe

    address public constant WETH = 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2;

    IEldergodsOld public immutable ELDERGODS_old;

    event NFTListedForRent(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint64 duration, uint64 deadline, uint256 amount, address paymentToken);
    event NFTDeletedFromRent(uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event UpdateUser(uint256 indexed tokenId, address user, uint64 expires);
    event BidPlaced(uint256 indexed bidId, uint256 tokenId, uint64 duration, uint64 deadline, uint256 amount, address paymentToken);
    event BidDeleted(uint256 indexed bidId);

    constructor(address oldCollection) {
        ELDERGODS_old = IEldergodsOld(oldCollection);
        _transferOwnership(msg.sender);
    }

    // --- ERC165 ---
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public pure returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == 0x2b424ad7 || // IERC4907-ish (rent interface)
            interfaceId == 0x780e9d63 || // ERC721Enumerable
            interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd || // ERC721
            interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f || // ERC721Metadata
            interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7;   // ERC165
    }

    // --- Metadata ---
    function name() public view returns (string memory) { return _name; }
    function symbol() public view returns (string memory) { return _symbol; }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (string memory) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        if (bytes(baseURI).length == 0) return "";
        return string(abi.encodePacked(baseURI, tokenId.toString(), baseExtension));
    }

    function setBaseURI(string calldata v) external onlyOwner { baseURI = v; }
    function setBaseExtension(string calldata v) external onlyOwner { baseExtension = v; }

    // --- ERC721 core ---
    function balanceOf(address o) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(o != address(0), "ERC721: address zero is not a valid owner");
        return _balances[o];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        address o = _owners[tokenId];
        require(o != address(0), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
        return o;
    }

    function _requireMinted(uint256 tokenId) internal view {
        require(_owners[tokenId] != address(0), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        _checkFilter(to);
        address o = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(to != o, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(msg.sender == o || isApprovedForAll(o, msg.sender),
            "ERC721: approve caller is not token owner or approved for all");
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit IERC721.Approval(o, to, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public {
        _checkFilter(operator);
        require(msg.sender != operator, "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit IERC721.ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address o, address op) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[o][op];
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        _checkFilter(from);
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner or approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        _checkFilter(from);
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner or approved");
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address o = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == o || getApproved(tokenId) == spender || isApprovedForAll(o, spender));
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");
        _beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);
        delete _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        emit IERC721.Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
                return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
            } catch (bytes memory reason) {
                if (reason.length == 0) {
                    revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
                } else {
                    assembly { revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason)) }
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    // --- Enumerable ---
    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) { return _allTokens.length; }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address o, uint256 i) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(i < balanceOf(o), "ERC721Enumerable: owner index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[o][i];
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 i) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(i < _allTokens.length, "ERC721Enumerable: global index out of bounds");
        return _allTokens[i];
    }

    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
            _allTokens.push(tokenId);
        } else if (from != to) {
            _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        }
        if (to == address(0)) {
            _removeTokenFromAllTokens(tokenId);
        } else if (to != from) {
            _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);
        }
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 len = balanceOf(to);
        _ownedTokens[to][len] = tokenId;
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = len;
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastIndex = balanceOf(from) - 1;
        uint256 idx = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        if (idx != lastIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][idx] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = idx;
        }
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        delete _ownedTokens[from][lastIndex];
    }

    function _removeTokenFromAllTokens(uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
        uint256 idx = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        uint256 last = _allTokens[lastIndex];
        _allTokens[idx] = last;
        _allTokensIndex[last] = idx;
        delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        _allTokens.pop();
    }

    // --- Operator filter ---
    function _checkFilter(address op) internal view {
        address reg = OPERATOR_FILTER_REGISTRY;
        if (reg.code.length == 0) return;
        require(IOperatorFilterRegistry(reg).isOperatorAllowed(address(this), op), "Operator not allowed");
    }

    function changeOperatorFilterRegistryAddress(address a) external onlyOwner {
        OPERATOR_FILTER_REGISTRY = a;
    }

    // --- Mint helper ---
    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(_owners[tokenId] == address(0), "ERC721: token already minted");
        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        emit IERC721.Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(address(0), to, tokenId, ""), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    // --- Rental / Bid functions ---
    function setRentStatus(bool v) external onlyOwner { canRent = v; }
    function changeRentFee(uint256 f) external onlyOwner {
        require(f < 1000, "Invalid fee");
        godsFee = f;
    }
    function changeTreasuryAddress(address t) external onlyOwner { treasury = t; }
    function modifyAllowedTokens(address[] calldata tokens, bool state) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            allowedTokens[tokens[i]] = state;
        }
        require(allowedTokens[WETH], "WETH must be allowed");
    }

    function putForRent(uint256 tokenId, uint64 duration, uint64 deadline, uint256 amount, address paymentToken) external {
        require(canRent, "GODS: Rent is currently disabled");
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        require(allowedTokens[paymentToken], "GODS: Token not allowed");
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender, "GODS: Caller is not owner");
        require(amount < 1000 ether, "GODS: Invalid amount");
        require(_users[tokenId].user == address(0) || _users[tokenId].expires < block.timestamp, "GODS: Currently rented");

        rentableItems[tokenId] = Rentable({
            tokenId: tokenId,
            amount: amount,
            lender: msg.sender,
            deadline: deadline,
            paymentToken: paymentToken,
            duration: duration
        });
        emit NFTListedForRent(tokenId, duration, deadline, amount, paymentToken);
    }

    function deleteFromRent(uint256 tokenId) external {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender, "GODS: Caller is not owner");
        delete rentableItems[tokenId].lender;
        emit NFTDeletedFromRent(tokenId);
    }

    function rent(uint256 tokenId) external payable nonReentrant {
        require(canRent, "GODS: Rent is currently disabled");
        Rentable memory r = rentableItems[tokenId];
        require(r.lender == ownerOf(tokenId), "GODS: Caller is not the owner");
        require(_users[tokenId].user == address(0) || _users[tokenId].expires < block.timestamp, "GODS: Currently rented");
        require(block.timestamp < r.deadline, "GODS: Expired");

        delete rentableItems[tokenId].deadline;

        if (godsFee > 0) {
            uint256 fee = (r.amount * ((1000 * godsFee) / 1000)) / 1000;
            uint256 rest = r.amount - fee;
            _payOrTransfer(ownerOf(tokenId), r.paymentToken, rest, msg.sender);
            if (fee > 0) {
                _payOrTransfer(godsToken, r.paymentToken, fee, msg.sender);
            }
        } else {
            _payOrTransfer(ownerOf(tokenId), r.paymentToken, r.amount, msg.sender);
        }

        _setUser(tokenId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp + r.duration));
    }

    function _payOrTransfer(address to, address token, uint256 amount, address from) internal {
        bytes memory data = abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount);
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.call(data);
        require(ok && (ret.length == 0 || abi.decode(ret, (bool))), "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
    }

    function placeBid(uint256 tokenId, uint64 duration, uint64 deadline, uint256 amount, address paymentToken) external {
        require(canRent, "GODS: Rent is currently disabled");
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        require(allowedTokens[paymentToken] || paymentToken == address(0), "GODS: Token not allowed");
        require(block.timestamp < deadline, "GODS: Invalid expiry");
        require(amount < 1000 ether, "GODS: Invalid amount");

        uint256 id = ++rentBidsCounter;
        rentBids[id] = Bid({
            bidId: id,
            tokenId: tokenId,
            bidder: msg.sender,
            amount: amount,
            paymentToken: paymentToken,
            duration: duration
        });
        emit BidPlaced(id, tokenId, duration, deadline, amount, paymentToken);
    }

    function deleteBid(uint256 bidId) external {
        require(rentBids[bidId].bidder == msg.sender, "GODS: Caller is not bidder");
        require(rentBids[bidId].amount < block.timestamp, "GODS: Currently rented");
        delete rentBids[bidId].amount;
        emit BidDeleted(bidId);
    }

    function acceptBid(uint256 bidId) external nonReentrant {
        require(canRent, "GODS: Rent is currently disabled");
        Bid memory b = rentBids[bidId];
        require(ownerOf(b.tokenId) == msg.sender, "GODS: Caller is not the owner");
        // payment + set user logic...
        _setUser(b.tokenId, b.bidder, uint64(block.timestamp + b.duration));
    }

    function acceptRent(uint256 bidId) external payable nonReentrant {
        require(canRent, "GODS: Rent is currently disabled");
        _requireMinted(bidId);
        Bid memory b = rentBids[bidId];
        require(ownerOf(b.tokenId) != msg.sender, "GODS: Cannot rent own token");
        require(b.bidder != ownerOf(b.tokenId), "GODS: Lender cannot rent");
        require(block.timestamp < b.duration, "GODS: Expired");

        delete rentBids[bidId].bidder;

        if (godsFee > 0) {
            uint256 fee = (b.amount * ((1000 * godsFee) / 1000)) / 1000;
            uint256 rest = b.amount - fee;
            if (b.paymentToken == address(0)) {
                require(msg.value == b.amount, "GODS: Incorrect amount paid");
                _sendETH(ownerOf(b.tokenId), rest);
                if (fee > 0) _sendETH(godsToken, fee);
            } else {
                _payOrTransfer(ownerOf(b.tokenId), b.paymentToken, rest, msg.sender);
                if (fee > 0) _payOrTransfer(godsToken, b.paymentToken, fee, msg.sender);
            }
        } else {
            if (b.paymentToken == address(0)) {
                _sendETH(ownerOf(b.tokenId), b.amount);
            } else {
                _payOrTransfer(ownerOf(b.tokenId), b.paymentToken, b.amount, msg.sender);
            }
        }

        _setUser(b.tokenId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp + b.duration));
    }

    function _sendETH(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, ) = payable(to).call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok, "Address: unable to send value");
    }

    function withdrawFunds() external onlyOwner {
        (bool ok, ) = payable(treasury).call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        require(ok, "Address: unable to send value");
    }

    // --- User (ERC4907) ---
    function setUser(uint256 tokenId, address user, uint64 expires) external {
        _checkFilter(user);
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner or approved");
        _setUser(tokenId, user, expires);
    }

    function _setUser(uint256 tokenId, address user, uint64 expires) internal {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        _users[tokenId] = RentInfo(user, expires);
        emit UpdateUser(tokenId, user, expires);
    }

    function userOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        if (_users[tokenId].expires >= block.timestamp) {
            return _users[tokenId].user;
        }
        return address(0);
    }

    function userExpires(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_users[tokenId].expires >= block.timestamp) {
            return _users[tokenId].expires;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // --- Airdrop ---
    function airdrop(uint256 maxGas) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        uint256 oldTotal = ELDERGODS_old.totalSupply();
        require(_allTokens.length < oldTotal, "GODS: Not all airdropped");
        require(treasury != address(0), "GODS: To address(0)");
        uint256 i = _airdropCursor;
        while (i < oldTotal && gasleft() > maxGas) {
            address o = ELDERGODS_old.ownerOf(i);
            if (ELDERGODS_old.isSloth(i)) {
                isSloth[i] = true;
            }
            _safeMint(o, i);
            i++;
        }
        _airdropCursor = i;
    }

    function returnToTreasury(uint256 startIdx) external onlyOwner {
        uint256 total = ELDERGODS_old.totalSupply();
        require(startIdx < total, "GODS: Not all airdropped");
        require(treasury != address(0), "GODS: To address(0)");
        uint256 i = startIdx;
        while (i < total && gasleft() > 100000) {
            _safeMint(treasury, i);
            i++;
        }
    }

    function getEldersSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        return ELDERGODS_old.totalSupply();
    }

    function ELDERGODS_old_() external view returns (address) { return address(ELDERGODS_old); }

    // --- Fallback revert ---
    fallback() external payable {
        revert("Function does not exist");
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

    function turnSaleOn(uint256 id) external onlyTeamOrOwner {
        mintPasses[id].saleIsOpen = true;
    }

    function turnSaleOff(uint256 id) external onlyTeamOrOwner {
        mintPasses[id].saleIsOpen = false;
    }

    function exists(uint256 id) external view returns (bool) {
        return totalSupply[id] > 0;
    }

    function getPrice(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        MintPass storage mp = mintPasses[id];
        if (!mp.isDutchAuction) return mp.price;
        uint256 elapsed;
        if (block.timestamp > mp.endPrice) {
            elapsed = block.timestamp - mp.endPrice;
        } else {
            elapsed = 0;
        }
        uint256 steps = elapsed / mp.priceDecrement;
        return mp.decrementFrequency * steps;
    }

    function getRemainingTimeBeforeNextPricingChange(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {
        MintPass storage mp = mintPasses[id];
        require(mp.isDutchAuction, "Sale is not a dutch auction");
        uint256 diff = block.timestamp > mp.endPrice ? block.timestamp - mp.endPrice : 0;
        return mp.priceDecrement - (diff % mp.priceDecrement);
    }

    function getDutchTiers(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256[] memory, uint256[] memory, uint256[] memory, uint256[] memory) {
        // Simplified placeholder returning empty arrays
        uint256[] memory a = new uint256[](0);
        return (a, a, a, a);
    }

    function getRemainingPassSupply(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {
        return mintPasses[id].maxSupply - totalSupply[id];
    }

    function getTokenSupply(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {
        return totalSupply[id];
    }

    function getClaimedMps(uint256 id, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return mintPasses[id].claimedByWallet[account];
    }

    function HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE_() external pure returns (string memory) { return "HABIBI_OPERATOR"; }

    function makeLeaf(address addr, uint256 amount) public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(addr, amount));
    }

    function verifyMerkleProof(bytes32[] memory proof, uint256 id, uint256 amount) public view returns (bool) {
        bytes32 leaf = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_msgSender(), amount));
        bytes32 computedHash = leaf;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) {
            bytes32 proofElement = proof[i];
            if (computedHash <= proofElement) {
                computedHash = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(computedHash, proofElement));
            } else {
                computedHash = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(proofElement, computedHash));
            }
        }
        return computedHash == mintPasses[id].merkleRoot;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account, uint256 id) public view override returns (uint256) {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC1155: balance query for the zero address");
        return _balances[id][account];
    }

    function balanceOfBatch(address[] memory accounts, uint256[] memory ids) public view override returns (uint256[] memory) {
        require(accounts.length == ids.length, "ERC1155: accounts and ids length mismatch");
        uint256[] memory batchBalances = new uint256[](accounts.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
            batchBalances[i] = balanceOf(accounts[i], ids[i]);
        }
        return batchBalances;
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public override {
        require(_msgSender() != operator, "ERC1155: setting approval status for self");
        _operatorApprovals[_msgSender()][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(_msgSender(), operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address account, address operator) public view override returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[account][operator];
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) public override {
        require(from == _msgSender() || isApprovedForAll(from, _msgSender()), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeTransferFrom(from, to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function safeBatchTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) public override {
        require(from == _msgSender() || isApprovedForAll(from, _msgSender()), "ERC1155: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeBatchTransferFrom(from, to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: transfer to the zero address");
        require(_balances[id][from] >= amount, "ERC1155: insufficient balance for transfer");
        unchecked { _balances[id][from] -= amount; }
        _balances[id][to] += amount;
        emit TransferSingle(_msgSender(), from, to, id, amount);
        _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(_msgSender(), from, to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function _safeBatchTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(ids.length == amounts.length, "ERC1155: ids and amounts length mismatch");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: transfer to the zero address");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; ++i) {
            uint256 id = ids[i];
            uint256 amount = amounts[i];
            require(_balances[id][from] >= amount, "ERC1155: insufficient balance for transfer");
            unchecked { _balances[id][from] -= amount; }
            _balances[id][to] += amount;
        }
        emit TransferBatch(_msgSender(), from, to, ids, amounts);
        _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(_msgSender(), from, to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

    function mint(address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: mint to the zero address");
        _balances[id][to] += amount;
        totalSupply[id] += amount;
        emit TransferSingle(_msgSender(), address(0), to, id, amount);
    }

    function mintBatch(address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts) external onlyOwner {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: mint to the zero address");
        require(ids.length == amounts.length, "ERC1155: ids and amounts length mismatch");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            _balances[ids[i]][to] += amounts[i];
            totalSupply[ids[i]] += amounts[i];
        }
        emit TransferBatch(_msgSender(), address(0), to, ids, amounts);
    }

    function burn(address account, uint256 id, uint256 amount) external {
        require(account == _msgSender() || isApprovedForAll(account, _msgSender()), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        require(_balances[id][account] >= amount, "ERC1155: burn amount exceeds balance");
        unchecked { _balances[id][account] -= amount; }
        totalSupply[id] -= amount;
        emit TransferSingle(_msgSender(), account, address(0), id, amount);
    }

    function burnBatch(address account, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts) external {
        require(account == _msgSender() || isApprovedForAll(account, _msgSender()), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        require(ids.length == amounts.length, "ERC1155: ids and amounts length mismatch");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            require(_balances[ids[i]][account] >= amounts[i], "ERC1155: burn amount exceeds balance");
            unchecked { _balances[ids[i]][account] -= amounts[i]; }
            totalSupply[ids[i]] -= amounts[i];
        }
        emit TransferBatch(_msgSender(), account, address(0), ids, amounts);
    }

    function burnFromRedeem(address account, uint256 id, uint256 amount) external {
        require(_msgSender() == mintPasses[id].redeemContract, "Burnable: Only allowed from redeem contract");
        require(_balances[id][account] >= amount, "ERC1155: burn amount exceeds balance");
        unchecked { _balances[id][account] -= amount; }
        totalSupply[id] -= amount;
        emit TransferSingle(_msgSender(), account, address(0), id, amount);
    }

    function addMintPass(
        bytes32 merkleRoot,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 maxSupply,
        uint256 openWindow,
        uint256 closeWindow,
        uint256 maxPerWallet,
        string memory tokenUri,
        address redeemContract,
        uint256 maxPerTransaction
    ) external onlyTeamOrOwner whenNotPaused {
        require(openWindow < closeWindow, "addMintPass: open window must be before close window");
        require(openWindow > 0 && closeWindow > 0, "addMintPass: window cannot be 0");
        uint256 id = mintPassCount;
        MintPass storage mp = mintPasses[id];
        mp.saleIsOpen = false;
        mp.merkleRoot = merkleRoot;
        mp.price = price;
        mp.maxSupply = maxSupply;
        mp.openWindow = openWindow;
        mp.closeWindow = closeWindow;
        mp.maxPerWallet = maxPerWallet;
        mp.maxPerTransaction = maxPerTransaction;
        mp.uri = tokenUri;
        mp.redeemContract = redeemContract;
        mintPassCount++;
    }

    function editMintPass(
        bytes32 merkleRoot,
        uint256 id,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 maxSupply,
        uint256 openWindow,
        uint256 closeWindow,
        string memory tokenUri,
        address redeemContract,
        uint256 maxPerWallet,
        bool saleIsOpen,
        uint256 maxPerTransaction
    ) external onlyTeamOrOwner {
        require(openWindow < closeWindow, "editMintPass: open window must be before close window");
        require(openWindow > 0 && closeWindow > 0, "editMintPass: window cannot be 0");
        MintPass storage mp = mintPasses[id];
        mp.merkleRoot = merkleRoot;
        mp.price = price;
        mp.maxSupply = maxSupply;
        mp.openWindow = openWindow;
        mp.closeWindow = closeWindow;
        mp.maxPerWallet = maxPerWallet;
        mp.maxPerTransaction = maxPerTransaction;
        mp.uri = tokenUri;
        mp.redeemContract = redeemContract;
        mp.saleIsOpen = saleIsOpen;
    }

    function editMintPassWhiteListMerkleRoot(bytes32 merkleRoot, uint256 id) external onlyTeamOrOwner {
        mintPasses[id].merkleRoot = merkleRoot;
    }

    function setDutchAuctionSettings(
        uint256 id,
        bool isDutch,
        uint256 startPrice,
        uint256 endPrice,
        uint256 priceDecrement,
        uint256 decrementFrequency,
        uint256 price
    ) external onlyTeamOrOwner {
        MintPass storage mp = mintPasses[id];
        mp.isDutchAuction = isDutch;
        mp.price = price;
        mp.endPrice = endPrice;
        mp.priceDecrement = priceDecrement;
        mp.decrementFrequency = decrementFrequency;
        mp.maxSupply = startPrice;
    }

    function claim(uint256 id, uint256 amount, uint256 allowance, bytes32[] memory proof) external payable whenNotPaused {
        MintPass storage mp = mintPasses[id];
        require(mp.saleIsOpen, "Sale not open");
        require(mp.openWindow > 0, "Claim: Mint pass does not exist");
        require(block.timestamp >= mp.openWindow && block.timestamp <= mp.closeWindow, "Claim: time window closed");
        uint256 price = getPrice(id);
        require(msg.value >= price * amount, "Claim: Ether value incorrect");
        require(mp.claimedByWallet[_msgSender()] + amount <= allowance, "Claim: Not allowed to claim given amount");
        require(mp.claimedByWallet[_msgSender()] + amount <= mp.maxPerWallet, "Claim: Not allowed to claim that quantity");
        require(amount <= mp.maxPerTransaction, "Max quantity per transaction exceeded");
        require(totalSupply[id] + amount <= mp.maxSupply, "Purchase would exceed max supply");
        require(verifyMerkleProof(proof, id, allowance), "MerkleDistributor: Invalid proof");

        uint256 excess = msg.value - (price * amount);
        if (excess > 0) {
            (bool ok,) = payable(_msgSender()).call{value: excess}("");
            require(ok, "Error returning excess payment");
        }

        mp.claimedByWallet[_msgSender()] += amount;
        _balances[id][_msgSender()] += amount;
        totalSupply[id] += amount;
        emit TransferSingle(_msgSender(), address(0), _msgSender(), id, amount);
        emit Claimed(id, _msgSender(), amount);
    }

    function claimMultiple(
        uint256[] memory ids,
        uint256[] memory amounts,
        uint256[] memory allowances,
        bytes32[][] memory proofs
    ) external payable whenNotPaused {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            require(verifyMerkleProof(proofs[i], ids[i], allowances[i]), "One or more claims are invalid");
        }
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            mintPasses[ids[i]].claimedByWallet[_msgSender()] += amounts[i];
            _balances[ids[i]][_msgSender()] += amounts[i];
        }
        emit TransferBatch(_msgSender(), address(0), _msgSender(), ids, amounts);
        emit ClaimedMultiple(ids, _msgSender(), amounts);
    }

    function withdrawEther(address payable to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        (bool ok,) = to.call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok, "Withdraw failed");
    }

    function _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(
        address operator,
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 id,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes memory data
    ) private {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC1155Receiver(to).onERC1155Received(operator, from, id, amount, data) returns (bytes4 response) {
                require(response == IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155Received.selector, "ERC1155: ERC1155Receiver rejected tokens");
            } catch Error(string memory reason) {
                revert(reason);
            } catch {
                revert("ERC1155: transfer to non ERC1155Receiver implementer");
            }
        }
    }

    function _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(
        address operator,
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256[] memory ids,
        uint256[] memory amounts,
        bytes memory data
    ) private {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC1155Receiver(to).onERC1155BatchReceived(operator, from, ids, amounts, data) returns (bytes4 response) {
                require(response == IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155BatchReceived.selector, "ERC1155: ERC1155Receiver rejected tokens");
            } catch Error(string memory reason) {
                revert(reason);
            } catch {
                revert("ERC1155: transfer to non ERC1155Receiver implementer");
            }
        }
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < remote.length; i++) remote[i] = path[i];
        return remote;
    }

    function isTrustedRemote(uint16 _chainId, bytes calldata _srcAddr) external view returns (bool) {
        return keccak256(trustedRemoteLookup[_chainId]) == keccak256(_srcAddr);
    }

    function setMinDstGas(uint16 _dst, uint16 _type, uint256 _gas) external onlyOwner {
        require(_gas > 0, "LzApp: invalid minGas");
        minDstGasLookup[_dst][_type] = _gas;
        emit SetMinDstGas(_dst, _type, _gas);
    }

    function setPayloadSizeLimit(uint16 _dst, uint256 _size) external onlyOwner {
        payloadSizeLimitLookup[_dst] = _size;
    }

    function setPrecrime(address _precrime) external onlyOwner {
        precrime = _precrime;
        emit SetPrecrime(_precrime);
    }

    function forceResumeReceive(uint16 _srcChainId, bytes calldata _srcAddress) external onlyOwner {
        lzEndpoint.forceResumeReceive(_srcChainId, _srcAddress);
    }

    function lzReceive(uint16 _srcChainId, bytes calldata _srcAddress, uint64 _nonce, bytes calldata _payload) external {
        require(msg.sender == address(lzEndpoint), "LzApp: invalid endpoint caller");
        bytes memory trusted = trustedRemoteLookup[_srcChainId];
        require(_srcAddress.length == trusted.length && trusted.length > 0 && keccak256(_srcAddress) == keccak256(trusted), "LzApp: invalid source sending contract");
        _blockingLzReceive(_srcChainId, _srcAddress, _nonce, _payload);
    }

    function _blockingLzReceive(uint16 _srcChainId, bytes memory _srcAddress, uint64 _nonce, bytes memory _payload) internal {
        (bool success, ) = address(this).call(abi.encodeWithSelector(this.nonblockingLzReceive.selector, _srcChainId, _srcAddress, _nonce, _payload));
        if (!success) {
            failedMessages[_srcChainId][_srcAddress][_nonce] = keccak256(_payload);
            emit MessageFailed(_srcChainId, _srcAddress, _nonce, _payload, "");
        }
    }

    function nonblockingLzReceive(uint16 _srcChainId, bytes calldata _srcAddress, uint64 _nonce, bytes calldata _payload) external {
        require(msg.sender == address(this), "NonblockingLzApp: caller must be LzApp");
        _nonblockingLzReceive(_srcChainId, _srcAddress, _nonce, _payload);
    }

    function _nonblockingLzReceive(uint16, bytes memory, uint64, bytes memory _payload) internal {
        uint16 pt;
        assembly { pt := and(mload(add(_payload, 2)), 0xffff) }
        require(pt == PT_SEND, "OFTCore: unknown packet type");
        // _sendAck decoding omitted
    }

    function retryMessage(uint16 _srcChainId, bytes calldata _srcAddress, uint64 _nonce, bytes calldata _payload) external payable {
        bytes32 ph = failedMessages[_srcChainId][_srcAddress][_nonce];
        require(ph != bytes32(0), "NonblockingLzApp: no stored message");
        require(keccak256(_payload) == ph, "NonblockingLzApp: invalid payload");
        failedMessages[_srcChainId][_srcAddress][_nonce] = bytes32(0);
        _nonblockingLzReceive(_srcChainId, _srcAddress, _nonce, _payload);
        emit RetryMessageSuccess(_srcChainId, _srcAddress, _nonce, ph);
    }

    function estimateSendFee(uint16 _dstChainId, bytes calldata _toAddress, uint256 _amount, bool _useZro, bytes calldata _adapterParams) external view returns (uint256 nativeFee, uint256 zroFee) {
        bytes memory payload = abi.encode(PT_SEND, _toAddress, _amount);
        return lzEndpoint.estimateFees(_dstChainId, address(this), payload, _useZro, _adapterParams);
    }

    function sendFrom(
        address _from,
        uint16 _dstChainId,
        bytes calldata _toAddress,
        uint256 _amount,
        address payable _refundAddress,
        address _zroPaymentAddress,
        bytes calldata _adapterParams
    ) external payable {
        require(_from == msg.sender, "not owner");
        bytes memory payload = abi.encode(PT_SEND, _toAddress, _amount);
        _burn(_from, _amount);
        lzEndpoint.send{value: msg.value}(_dstChainId, trustedRemoteLookup[_dstChainId], payload, _refundAddress, _zroPaymentAddress, _adapterParams);
        emit SendToChain(_dstChainId, _from, _toAddress, _amount);
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || interfaceId == 0x0a726775;
    }

    function token() external view returns (address) {
        return address(this);
    }

    function circulatingSupplyFunc() external view returns (uint256) {
        return totalSupply;
    }
}

            if (!success && revertOnFail) {
                revert(_getRevertMsg(result));
            }
        }
    }

        if (returnData.length < 68) return "Transaction reverted silently";
        assembly { returnData := add(returnData, 0x04) }
        return abi.decode(returnData, (string));
    }

        (uint256 reserve0,) = _getReserves(from, to);
        address pair = _pairFor(from, to);

        IUniswapPair(pair).swap(0, amt, recipient, "");
        return amt;
    }

    function swapBalance(address from, address to, address recipient) external returns (uint256) {
        uint256 amount = _balanceOf(from);
        return _swap(from, to, recipient, amount);
    }

    function _swap(address, address, address, uint256) internal returns (uint256) { return 0; }

    function _getReserves(address, address) internal pure returns (uint256, uint256) { return (0, 0); }

    function _pairFor(address, address) internal pure returns (address) { return address(0); }

    function zapIn(address from, address to, address recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 minOut, address pair, bytes calldata data) external payable returns (uint256) {
        emit ZapIn(from, to, amount);
        return minOut;
    }

    function zapToBento(address from, address to, address recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 minOut, address pair, bytes calldata data) external payable returns (uint256) {
        emit ZapIn(from, to, amount);
        return minOut;

    function zapToKashi(address from, address to, address recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 minOut, address pair, bytes calldata data) external returns (uint256) {

        return minOut;

        emit ZapIn(from, to, amount);
        return minOut;
    }

    function zapFromBento(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external {
        IBentoBox(BENTOBOX).withdraw(from, msg.sender, address(this), amount, 0);
    }
}

        _owner = msg.sender;

    function removeRole(uint8 role) external onlyOwner {

    }

    function _setRole(uint8 role, address account) internal {
        RoleStatus storage s = _rolesFull[role];
        if (s.account != account) {
            s.account = account;
            emit RoleModified(role, account);
        }
    }

    function pause(uint8 role) external {
        require(_isPauser(), "TwoStepOwnable: caller is not the owner.");
        RoleStatus storage s = _rolesFull[role];
        require(!s.paused, "Role in question is already paused.");
        s.paused = true;
        emit RolePaused(role);
    }

    function unpause(uint8 role) external onlyOwner {
        RoleStatus storage s = _rolesFull[role];
        require(s.paused, "Role in question is currently unpaused.");
        s.paused = false;
        emit RoleUnpaused(role);
    }

    function isPaused(uint8 role) external view returns (bool) {
        return _rolesFull[role].paused;
    }

    function isRole(uint8 role) external view returns (bool) {

    function _isDepositManager() internal view returns (bool) { return _rolesFull[1].account == msg.sender; }

    function _isReserveTrader() internal view returns (bool) { return _rolesFull[3].account == msg.sender; }

    function _isSmartWallet(address wallet, address dkey) internal view returns (bool) {
        // Placeholder: checks via helper
        (wallet; dkey);
        return true;
    }

    function _transferInERC20(address token, address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory r) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transferFrom.selector, from, address(this), amount));
        require(ok && (r.length == 0 || abi.decode(r, (bool))), "transferFrom failed");
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory r) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, amount));
        require(ok && (r.length == 0 || abi.decode(r, (bool))), "transfer failed");
    }

    function _approveIfNeeded(address token, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 a = IERC20(token).allowance(address(this), spender);
        if (a < amount) {
            IERC20(token).approve(spender, 0);
            IERC20(token).approve(spender, uint256(-1));
        }
    }

    function _sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b <= a, "SafeMath: subtraction overflow");
        return a - b;
    }

    function _mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256 c) {
        if (a == 0) return 0;
        c = a * b;
        require(c / a == b, "SafeMath: multiplication overflow");
    }

    function _div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b > 0, "SafeMath: division by zero");
        return a / b;
    }

    function _mulDiv(uint256 a, uint256 b, uint256 c) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return _div(_mul(a, b), c);
    }
