        _approve(msg.sender, s, a); return true;
    }
    function transferFrom(address f, address t, uint256 a) public override returns (bool) {
        _spendAllowance(f, msg.sender, a);
        _transfer(f, t, a);
        return true;
    }
    function increaseAllowance(address s, uint256 a) public returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, s, _allowances[msg.sender][s] + a);
        return true;
    }
    function decreaseAllowance(address s, uint256 a) public returns (bool) {
        uint256 cur = _allowances[msg.sender][s];
        require(cur >= a, "ERC20: decreased allowance below zero");
        _approve(msg.sender, s, cur - a);
        return true;
    }

    function _spendAllowance(address o, address s, uint256 a) internal {
        uint256 cur = _allowances[o][s];
        if (cur != type(uint256).max) {
            require(cur >= a, "ERC20: insufficient allowance");
            _approve(o, s, cur - a);
        }
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from the zero address");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to the zero address");
        uint256 bal = _balances[from];
        require(bal >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance");
        unchecked { _balances[from] = bal - amount; }
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: mint to the zero address");
        _totalSupply += amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: burn from the zero address");
        uint256 bal = _balances[from];
        require(bal >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance");
        unchecked { _balances[from] = bal - amount; }
        _totalSupply -= amount;
        emit Transfer(from, address(0), amount);
    }

    function _approve(address o, address s, uint256 a) internal {
        require(o != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(s != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");
        _allowances[o][s] = a;
        emit Approval(o, s, a);
    }
}

library SafeERC20 {
    function safeTransfer(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        _callOptional(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transfer.selector, to, value));
    }
    function _callOptional(IERC20 token, bytes memory data) private {
        (bool success, bytes memory ret) = address(token).call(data);
        require(success, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (ret.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        }
    }
}

contract MemeKong is Initializable, ERC20Upgradeable, OwnableUpgradeable {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    // Storage layout (starting slot 0x65 based on _balances mapping, etc.)
    // slot 0x97: staker storage
    IStakerStorage public stakerStorage;
    // slot 0x98: bots/blacklist mapping
    mapping(address => bool) public bots;
    // slot 0x99: admin
    address public admin;
    // slot 0x9a: uniPool
    address public uniPool;
    // slot 0x9b: owner2 / uniswapV2Router
    IUniswapV2Router02 public uniswapV2Router;
    // slot 0x9c: totalStaked
    uint256 public totalStaked;
    // slot 0x9d: burnAdjust
    uint256 public burnAdjust;
    // slot 0x9e: poolBurnAdjust
    uint256 public poolBurnAdjust;
    // slot 0x9f: sellAdminPercentageMax
    uint256 public sellAdminPercentageMax;
    // slot 0xa0: maximumStakingAmount (raw)
    uint256 public maximumStakingAmountRaw;
    // slot 0xa1: maximumStakingAmount
    uint256 public maximumStakingAmount;
    // slot 0xa2: maxTransactionAmount
    uint256 public maxTaxAmount;
    // slot 0xa3: minMkong
    uint256 public _minMkong;
    // slot 0xa4: buyAdminCommission
    uint256 public buyAdminCommission;
    // slot 0xa5: sellAdminCommission
    uint256 public sellAdminCommission;
    // slot 0xa6: dynamicSellTax
    uint256 public dynamicSellTax;
    // slot 0xa7: sellAdminExtra
    uint256 public sellAdminExtra;
    // slot 0xa8: swapTokensAmount
    uint256 public _swapTokensAmount;
    // slot 0xa9: burnPercentage
    uint256 public burnPercentage;
    // slot 0xaa: decimals
    uint8 internal _decimalsValue;
    // slot 0xab: minMkongTokens
    uint256 public minMkongTokens;
    // slot 0xac: swapTokensAmountRaw
    uint256 public swapTokensAmountRaw;
    // slot 0xad: stakingRewardsPool
    uint256 public stakingRewardsPool;
    // slot 0xae: locks (syncLock | initLock)
    bool internal _syncLock;
    bool internal _contractLocked;
    // slot 0xaf: basisPointsForLPBurn
    uint256 public basisPointsForLPBurn;
    // slot 0xb0: lpBurnEnabled
    bool public lpBurnEnabled;
    // slot 0xb1: lpBurnFrequency
    uint256 public lpBurnFrequency;
    // slot 0xb2: lastLpBurnTime
    uint256 public lastLpBurnTime;

    uint256 public constant UNSTAKE_TIMEOFF = 0;

    event TokenStake(address indexed user, uint256 amount);
    event UniSwapBuySell(address indexed user, address indexed pair, uint256 a, uint256 b, uint256 c);
    event SwapFailed(uint256 amount);

    modifier lockTheSwap() {
        require(!_syncLock, "Sync lock");
        _syncLock = true;
        _;
        _syncLock = false;
    }

    function init(uint256 decimals_, address router_, address feeReceiver_, address poolAdmin_) external initializer {
        __Ownable_init();
        __ERC20_init("MEME KONG", "MKONG");

        stakerStorage = IStakerStorage(router_);
        burnAdjust = 10;
        _decimalsValue = 9;
        poolBurnAdjust = 100;
        sellAdminPercentageMax = 60;
        maximumStakingAmountRaw = 86400;
        maximumStakingAmount = (10 ** _decimalsValue) * 2000000;
        maxTaxAmount = (10 ** _decimalsValue) * 2000000;
        _minMkong = 1251;
        buyAdminCommission = 0;
        sellAdminCommission = 18;
        dynamicSellTax = 18;
        sellAdminExtra = 2;
        _swapTokensAmount = (10 ** _decimalsValue) * 4000;
        burnPercentage = 2;
        swapTokensAmountRaw = 10000000000000;
        minMkongTokens = maximumStakingAmountRaw * 9;
        _contractLocked = false;

        admin = feeReceiver_;
        _mint(msg.sender, decimals_);
        uniswapV2Router = IUniswapV2Router02(poolAdmin_);
        _createPair(address(this), poolAdmin_);
    }

    function _createPair(address tokenA, address router) internal {
        address factory = IUniswapV2Router02(router).factory();
        address weth = IUniswapV2Router02(router).WETH();
        uniPool = IUniswapV2Factory(factory).createPair(tokenA, weth);
        require(uniPool != address(0), "Pair Address Zero");
    }

    // ============ View ============
    function viewStakingRewardsPool() external view returns (uint256) { return stakingRewardsPool; }
    function viewCurrentSellTax() external view returns (uint256) { return sellAdminCommission; }
    function mkongBalance() external view returns (uint256) { return _balanceOfThis(msg.sender); }

    function _balanceOfThis(address user) internal view returns (uint256) {
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(user);
        return s.stakedAmount;
    }

    function calcStakingRewards(address user) public view returns (uint256) {
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(user);
        return s.pendingRewards;
    }

    function minsPastStakeTime(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(user);
        if (s.stakedAmount == 0) return 0;
        uint256 maxTime = minMkongTokens;
        StakerInfo memory s2 = stakerStorage.getStaker(user);
        if (s2.stakedAmount + maxTime <= block.timestamp) return 0;
        return 1;
    }

    function isClaimable(address user) external view returns (bool) {
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(user);
        if (s.stakedAmount == 0) return false;
        uint256 period = maximumStakingAmount;
        StakerInfo memory s2 = stakerStorage.getStaker(user);
        if (s2.lastClaimTime + period > block.timestamp) return false;
        return true;
    }

    function timeDiffForClaim(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(user);
        if (s.stakedAmount == 0) return 0;
        StakerInfo memory s2 = stakerStorage.getStaker(user);
        return (s2.lastClaimTime + maximumStakingAmount) - block.timestamp;
    }

    function apyUnique(uint256 amount) external view returns (uint256 dyn) {
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        uint256 bal = s.pendingRewards;
        uint256 denom = 10000;
        uint256 result;
        if (denom != 0) {
            uint256 scaled = bal * (10 ** _decimalsValue);
            if (scaled < denom) result = 1000;
            else {
                uint256 part = (amount * 100) / scaled;
                uint256 got = (part * bal) / 100;
                result = got * bal;
                if (result < 1000) result = 1000;
            }
        }
        return (stakingRewardsPool * (result * amount)) / 10 ** _decimalsValue;
    }

    function mkongBalanceAccount(address a) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[a];
    }

    function decimals() public view override returns (uint8) { return _decimalsValue; }

    // ============ Admin setters ============
    function setStaker(address s) external onlyOwner {
        require(s != address(0), "Invalid Address");
        stakerStorage = IStakerStorage(s);
    }

    function setUniswapRouterAddress(address r) external onlyOwner {
        uniswapV2Router = IUniswapV2Router02(r);
    }

    function setAdmin(address a) external onlyOwner { admin = a; }

    function blockBots(address a) external onlyOwner {
        require(a != address(uniPool), "cannot block pool address");
        bots[a] = true;
    }

    function unblockBot(address a) external onlyOwner { bots[a] = false; }

    function setMinMkong(uint256 v) external onlyOwner { _minMkong = v; }

    function setBuyAdminCommission(uint256 v) external onlyOwner {
        require(v <= 25, "cannot set buy tax above 25%");
        buyAdminCommission = v;
    }

    function setSellAdminCommission(uint256 v) external onlyOwner {
        require(v <= 25, "cannot set sell tax above 25%");
        sellAdminCommission = v;
    }

    function setDynamicPercentage(uint256 v) external onlyOwner {
        require(v <= 25, "cannot set dynamic sell tax above 25%");
        dynamicSellTax = v;
    }

    function setBurnPercentage(uint256 v) external onlyOwner {
        require(v <= 25, "cannot set burn percentage above 25%");
        burnPercentage = v;
    }

    function setBurnAdjust(uint256 v) external onlyOwner {
        require(!_contractLocked, "cannot change burn rate");
        burnAdjust = v;
    }

    function uniPoolBurnAdjust(uint256 v) external onlyOwner {
        require(!_contractLocked, "cannot change pool burn rate");
        require(v <= 20, "cannot set pool burn rate above 5%");
        poolBurnAdjust = v;
    }

    function setMaxTransactionAmount(uint256 v) external onlyOwner {
        require(v >= 10000000000000, "cannot set max transaction below 10k MKONG");
        maxTaxAmount = v;
    }

    function setSellAdminPercentageMax(uint256 v) external onlyOwner {
        require(v <= 25, "cannot set dynamic sell tax above 25%");
        dynamicSellTax = v;
    }

    function setUnstakeTimeoffInNumDays(uint256 v) external onlyOwner {
        require(v <= 25, "cannot set buy tax above 25%");
        _minMkong = v;
    }

    function setSwapTokensAmount(uint256 v) external onlyOwner {
        _swapTokensAmount = 10 ** _decimalsValue * v;
    }

    function setUnipool(address a) external onlyOwner {
        uniPool = a;
    }

    function setAutoLPBurnSettings(uint256 freq, uint256 bp, bool enabled) external onlyOwner {
        require(bp <= 500, "Must set auto LP burn percent between 0% and 5%");
        require(freq >= 600, "Frequency cannot be less than 10 minutes");
        lpBurnFrequency = freq;
        basisPointsForLPBurn = bp;
        lpBurnEnabled = enabled;
    }

    function unlockTrading() external onlyOwner {
        _contractLocked = false;
    }

    function lockTrading() external onlyOwner {
        _contractLocked = true;
    }

    function addToStakingRewardsPool(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _transfer(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        stakingRewardsPool += amount;
    }

    function sendEthToAdmin(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount <= address(this).balance, "Insufficient ETH balance");
        (bool ok, ) = payable(address(uniswapV2Router)).call{value: amount}("");
        ok;
    }

    function rescueAnyERC20Tokens(address token, address to, uint128 amount) external onlyOwner {
        if (token != address(this)) {
            uint256 bal = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
            uint256 reserved = stakingRewardsPool + totalStaked;
            require(reserved + amount <= bal,
                "Cannot withdraw more than available balance after accounting for staked and reward pool tokens");
        }
        IERC20(token).safeTransfer(to, amount);
    }

    // ============ Staking ============
    function StakeTokens(uint256 amount) external {
        require(!_syncLock, "Sync lock");
        _syncLock = true;
        require(amount > 0, "amount cannot be 0");
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        require(amount <= s.stakedAmount, "Maximum staking limit reached");
        require(amount < _balances[msg.sender], "Error: insufficient balance");
        require(stakingRewardsPool > 0, "Error: the rewards pool is empty, further staking is not allowed");
        _claimInterest();
        StakerInfo memory s2 = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        s2.isStaking = true;
        s2.stakedAmount = s2.stakedAmount + amount;
        stakerStorage.setStaker(msg.sender, s2);
        totalStaked += amount;
        _transfer(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        emit TokenStake(msg.sender, amount);
        _syncLock = false;
    }

    function UnstakeTokens(uint256 amount, bool withPenalty) external {
        require(!_syncLock, "Sync lock");
        _syncLock = true;
        require(amount > 0, "unstake cannot be 0");
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        require(amount <= s.stakedAmount, "unstake amount is bigger than your stake");
        uint256 pending = calcStakingRewards(msg.sender);
        uint256 rewardsPool = stakingRewardsPool;
        if (pending > rewardsPool) pending = rewardsPool;
        uint256 toSend;
        if (withPenalty) {
            uint256 penalty = (amount * 9) / 100;
            toSend = amount - penalty;
        } else {
            toSend = amount;
        }
        StakerInfo memory s2 = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        s2.stakedAmount = s2.stakedAmount - amount;
        s2.lastClaimTime = block.timestamp;
        if (withPenalty) {
            _transfer(address(this), msg.sender, toSend);
            _burn(msg.sender, toSend);
            stakerStorage.setStaker(msg.sender, s2);
            totalStaked -= amount;
        } else {
            s2.unstakeRequestTime = block.timestamp;
            s2.pendingUnstake += toSend;
            stakerStorage.setStaker(msg.sender, s2);
        }
        _syncLock = false;
    }

    function ClaimStakeInterest() external {
        require(!_syncLock, "Sync lock");
        _syncLock = true;
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        require(s.stakedAmount > 0, "you have no staked balance");
        _claimInterest();
        _syncLock = false;
    }

    function RollStakeInterest() external {
        require(!_syncLock, "Sync lock");
        _syncLock = true;
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        require(s.stakedAmount > 0, "you have no staked balance");
        _rollInterest();
        _syncLock = false;
    }

    function ClaimUnStakeAmount() external {
        require(!_syncLock, "Sync lock");
        _syncLock = true;
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        require(s.pendingUnstake > 0, "you have no pending tokens to claim");
        _claimUnstake();
        _syncLock = false;
    }

    function BurnMkong(uint256 amount) external {
        require(!_syncLock, "Sync lock");
        _syncLock = true;
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        uint256 limit = burnAdjust * s.pendingRewards;
        require(amount <= limit, "can only burn equivalent of x10 of your pending rewards");
        require(amount > 0, "value must be greater than 0");
        require(amount <= _balances[msg.sender], "balance too low");
        _burn(msg.sender, amount);
        StakerInfo memory s2 = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        s2.pendingRewards = s2.pendingRewards + amount;
        stakerStorage.setStaker(msg.sender, s2);

        uint256 burnable = (poolBurnAdjust * _balanceOfThis(uniPool)) / 10000;
        if (amount > burnable) {
            _burn(uniPool, burnable);
        } else {
            _burn(uniPool, amount);
        }
        IUniswapV2Pair(uniPool).sync();
        _syncLock = false;
    }

    function _claimInterest() internal {
        uint256 pending = calcStakingRewards(msg.sender);
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        s.lastClaimTime = block.timestamp;
        if (pending > 0) {
            s.totalRewardsClaimed += pending;
            _transfer(address(this), msg.sender, pending);
            stakingRewardsPool -= pending;
        }
        stakerStorage.setStaker(msg.sender, s);
    }

    function _rollInterest() internal {
        uint256 pending = calcStakingRewards(msg.sender);
        if (pending == 0) return;
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        s.stakedAmount += pending;
        totalStaked += pending;
        stakingRewardsPool -= pending;
        s.totalRewardsClaimed += pending;
        s.lastClaimTime = block.timestamp;
        stakerStorage.setStaker(msg.sender, s);
    }

    function _claimUnstake() internal {
        StakerInfo memory s = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        require(s.pendingUnstake + 9 days <= block.timestamp, "invalid time: must be greater than 9 days");
        StakerInfo memory s2 = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        uint256 pendingAmt = s2.pendingUnstake;
        require(pendingAmt > 0, "no pending tokens to claim");
        require(pendingAmt <= _balanceOfThis(address(this)), "Insufficient MKONG balance in staking contract");
        _transfer(address(this), msg.sender, pendingAmt);
        totalStaked -= pendingAmt;
        StakerInfo memory s3 = stakerStorage.getStaker(msg.sender);
        s3.pendingUnstake = 0;
        s3.lastClaimTime = block.timestamp;
        stakerStorage.setStaker(msg.sender, s3);
    }

    // ============ LP Burn ============
    function _autoBurnLP(uint256 amount) internal returns (bool) {
        require(!_syncLock, "Sync lock");
        _syncLock = true;
        lastLpBurnTime = block.timestamp;
        uint256 bal = _balanceOfThis(uniPool);
        uint256 amountToBurn = (basisPointsForLPBurn * bal) / 10000;
        if (amountToBurn > 0) _burn(uniPool, amountToBurn);
        try IUniswapV2Pair(uniPool).sync() {
            _syncLock = false;
            return true;
        } catch {
            emit SwapFailed(amountToBurn);
            _syncLock = false;
            return false;
        }
    }

    function _swapBack(uint256 amt) internal {
        require(!_syncLock, "Sync lock");
        _syncLock = true;
        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = address(this);
        path[1] = uniswapV2Router.WETH();
        _approve(address(this), address(uniswapV2Router), amt);
        try uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(
            amt, 0, path, address(this), block.timestamp
        ) {
            _syncLock = false;
        } catch {
            emit SwapFailed(amt);
            _syncLock = false;
        }
    }

    // ============ Overridden transfer ============
    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal override {
        require(!_syncLock, "TOKEN: Contract is Locked");
        require(!bots[from] && !bots[to], "TOKEN: Your account is blacklisted!");

        bool skipTax = (owner() == from || owner() == to || address(this) == to)
            || admin == from || admin == to
            || uniPool == from || uniPool == to;

        if (skipTax && maxTaxAmount < amount) {
            require(amount <= maxTaxAmount, "More than Max Transaction limit");
        }

        if (owner() == from || owner() == to || address(this) == to) {
            super._transfer(from, to, amount);
            return;
        }

        if (from != uniPool && to != uniPool) {
            super._transfer(from, to, amount);
            return;
        }

        if (to == uniPool) {
            // sell
            uint256 buyComm = (buyAdminCommission * amount) / 100;
            uint256 taxed = amount - buyComm;
            super._transfer(from, address(this), buyComm);
            super._transfer(from, to, taxed);
            if (amount > _swapTokensAmount) {
                if (dynamicSellTax > sellAdminCommission) {
                    sellAdminCommission = 2;
                } else {
                    sellAdminCommission = sellAdminCommission + dynamicSellTax;
                }
            }
            emit UniSwapBuySell(from, msg.sender, buyComm, taxed, amount);
            return;
        }

        // buy
        if (!_syncLock && lpBurnEnabled && (lpBurnFrequency + lastLpBurnTime < block.timestamp)) {
            _autoBurnLP(stakingRewardsPool);
        }
        uint256 contractBal = _balanceOfThis(address(this));
        uint256 swapAmt = stakingRewardsPool - contractBal;
        uint256 rewardsThresh = swapTokensAmountRaw;
        if (swapAmt >= rewardsThresh && !_syncLock) {
            _swapBack(swapTokensAmountRaw);
        }
        uint256 sellComm = (sellAdminCommission * amount) / 100;
        uint256 burnAmt = (burnPercentage * amount) / 100;
        uint256 taxedB = amount - sellComm - burnAmt;
        _burn(from, burnAmt);
        super._transfer(from, address(this), sellComm);
        super._transfer(from, to, taxedB);
        if (amount > _swapTokensAmount) {
            if (sellAdminCommission < sellAdminPercentageMax) {
                uint256 next = sellAdminCommission + sellAdminExtra;
                if (next > sellAdminPercentageMax) sellAdminCommission = sellAdminPercentageMax;
                else sellAdminCommission = next;
            } else {
                sellAdminCommission = sellAdminPercentageMax;
            }
        }
        emit UniSwapBuySell(to, msg.sender, sellComm, burnAmt, taxedB);
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}
